programme.title: Разве можно мечтать о большем
programme.desc: Мечту скромной медсестры Ксении о прекрасной жизни в новом месте с любимым человеком неожиданно разбивает известие о тяжелой болезни ее мамы. Ксения вынуждена отменить свой переезд за границу и искать деньги на дорогостоящую операцию. Оставшись одна, без жилья и без работы, она пытается сделать все, что в ее силах. Неожиданно она получает предложение стать сиделкой в доме обеспеченной вдовы Ольги Болговой. Ксения с радостью принимает это предложение. Новый дом и его обитатели поначалу пугают ее, но постепенно Ксения привыкает. Она пытается наладить жизнь в доме и помочь выздороветь Ольге. К ее радости, ей начинает это удаваться. Но на самом деле Ксения еще не понимает, в какую опасную игру ее втянули…

programme.title: Дневники Темного
programme.desc: Телеканал ТЕТ подготовил для вас нечто очень неожиданное. Проект придется по вкусу всем любителям загадочных мистических историй. События происходят в фантастическом городе Темный. В нем живут вампиры, оборотни и другие существа. Все здесь живет и дышит, даже стены домов. Попасть в этот загадочный город совсем не сложно, а вот покинуть - невероятно сложно. Однажды в город приезжает журналист. Его задача - освещать события, происходящие в Темном. Однако все осложняется тем, что отличить где правда, а где только галлюцинации, в городе бывает невероятно трудно. В каждом выпуске он расследует новые мистические дела. Удастся ли ему раскрыть их и спасти жизни людей? Сможет ли журналист выжить в таинственном городе? А выбраться из него? - Узнавайте в мистическом сериалы "Дневники Темного".

programme.title: Семейные мелодрамы
programme.desc: Это не выдуманные истории, а реконструкция реальных событий, которые могут случиться с каждой семьей. В каждой семье свои "Семейные мелодрамы", конфликты, накопившиеся проблемы с долговыми ямами, изменами, трудными детьми и конфликтами с родителями. Какой выход из этих ситуаций, достигших наивысшего апогея, когда никто не хочет его искать? Как же тогда жить дальше? Эти фильмы не заканчиваются хэппи-эндом, но, тем не менее, они будут интересны самому широкому кругу зрителей: от самых маленьких до людей в возрасте. Сюжет фильма обычно предполагает некое размышление или обсуждение, потому что он поднимает важные философские вопросы, заставляет задуматься о понятиях "любовь", "дружба", "верность", "предательство". Помимо главной мелодраматической линии отношений героев, фильмы из подборки "Семейных мелодрам" содержат и философский, и морально-нравственный подтекст, и авторскую позицию по ключевым вопросам бытия. Вместе с тем, это не нудное поучительное рассуждение. Ленты также повествуют о личном выборе героя в сложных жизненных обстоятельствах, которые будут близки всем зрителям.

programme.title: Полевой госпиталь
programme.desc: В небольшом городке у польского приграничья, где во время полномасштабного вторжения России в Украину развернули полевой госпиталь, бок о бок трудятся украинские медики, волонтёры и квалифицированные специалисты из Израиля, Польши, США и других стран. Они оставили свою мирную жизнь ради того, чтобы спасать людей, пострадавших от войны. Каждый день здесь — это сочетание тяжёлых вызовов и веры в лучшее. Среди пациентов есть и военные, мужественно защищающие Украину, и мирные жители, каждый со своей нередко основанной на реальности историей. В этом месте, среди отголосков войны, продолжается жизнь: здесь появляются на свет дети, а порой — даже возникает любовь, несмотря на все испытания.

Они оставили свою мирную жизнь ради того, чтобы спасать людей, пострадавших от войны. Каждый день здесь — это сочетание тяжёлых вызовов и веры в лучшее. Среди пациентов есть и военные, мужественно защищающие Украину, и мирные жители, каждый со своей нередко основанной на реальности историей. В этом месте, среди отголосков войны, продолжается жизнь: здесь появляются на свет дети, а порой — даже возникает любовь, несмотря на все испытания.

programme.title: Семейные мелодрамы
programme.desc: Это не выдуманные истории, а реконструкция реальных событий, которые могут случиться с каждой семьей. В каждой семье свои "Семейные мелодрамы", конфликты, накопившиеся проблемы с долговыми ямами, изменами, трудными детьми и конфликтами с родителями. Какой выход из этих ситуаций, достигших наивысшего апогея, когда никто не хочет его искать? Как же тогда жить дальше? Эти фильмы не заканчиваются хэппи-эндом, но, тем не менее, они будут интересны самому широкому кругу зрителей: от самых маленьких до людей в возрасте. Сюжет фильма обычно предполагает некое размышление или обсуждение, потому что он поднимает важные философские вопросы, заставляет задуматься о понятиях "любовь", "дружба", "верность", "предательство". Помимо главной мелодраматической линии отношений героев, фильмы из подборки "Семейных мелодрам" содержат и философский, и морально-нравственный подтекст, и авторскую позицию по ключевым вопросам бытия. Вместе с тем, это не нудное поучительное рассуждение. Ленты также повествуют о личном выборе героя в сложных жизненных обстоятельствах, которые будут близки всем зрителям.

programme.title: Женский доктор
programme.desc: Действие разворачивается в новой современной клинике, которую основал профессор Юрий Климов. Бывшему тестю доктора Романа Широкова остался лишь год до выхода на пенсию, и за это время он должен найти достойного преемника. Но это не главная причина, по которой профессор вновь приглашает Романа работать вместе. Роман Широков – единственный, кто может довести до конца инновационную научную разработку, от которой зависит судьба дочери профессора - Нины. Однако инвесторы и сотрудники клиники не рады появлению нового профессионала.

programme.title: Школа
programme.desc: Успешная бизнес-леди Катя узнает, что её дочь пыталась покончить жизнь самоубийством. Как оказалось, не впервые. Чтобы быть ближе к дочери и понять, чем на самом деле занимаются дети в школе, она начинает работать учительницей экономики. Молодая мама понятия не имела, какие секреты скрываются за стенами обычной школы. Тогда же в учебное заведение приходит новый преподаватель английского - бывший адвокат и сын директора Алекс. У него есть невеста, которая живет в США, но вдруг между ним и Екатериной промелькнула искра. Впрочем, скелеты прошлого всё ещё дают о себе знать и не отпускают героев...

programme.title: Не хочу тебя терять
programme.desc: Соня с детства влюблена в своего одноклассника Андрея, но он предпочел ей другую - красавицу Таню. Спустя семь лет судьба снова сталкивает Андрея и Соню. Соня, как и мечтала в юности, стала отличным хирургом, а Андрей успешным архитектором. Только любви настоящей не случилось ни у нее, ни у него.

programme.title: Почта
programme.desc: В почтовое отделение на должность экспедитора устраивается Елена (40 лет). Экспедитор Андрей (45) не очень доволен новой напарницей, он не доверяет женщинам за рулем. Но со временем между Еленой и Андреем возникает симпатия. И не без стараний со стороны их детей – Юли и Глеба. Андрей – одинокий папа, Елена - одинокая мама, казалось бы, ничего не может помешать их отношениям… Но тайны и ошибки прошлого сыграют с ними злую шутку… Бушуют страсти и в почтовом отделении. Руководитель отделения Артем (30) покоряет вершины почтовой карьеры и не желает замечать сотрудницу отделения Милану (25), которая мечтает заполучить его сердце. Мама Артема и его младший брат Гена также вносят в жизнь отделения свои коррективы… Все герои ежедневно сталкиваются с нестандартными ситуациями, но не остаются равнодушными к проблемам людей-клиентов почтового отделения, помогая им выпутаться из сложных историй…

programme.title: Дневники Темного
programme.desc: Телеканал ТЕТ подготовил для вас нечто очень неожиданное. Проект придется по вкусу всем любителям загадочных мистических историй. События происходят в фантастическом городе Темный. В нем живут вампиры, оборотни и другие существа. Все здесь живет и дышит, даже стены домов. Попасть в этот загадочный город совсем не сложно, а вот покинуть - невероятно сложно. Однажды в город приезжает журналист. Его задача - освещать события, происходящие в Темном. Однако все осложняется тем, что отличить где правда, а где только галлюцинации, в городе бывает невероятно трудно. В каждом выпуске он расследует новые мистические дела. Удастся ли ему раскрыть их и спасти жизни людей? Сможет ли журналист выжить в таинственном городе? А выбраться из него? - Узнавайте в мистическом сериалы "Дневники Темного".

Эти фильмы не заканчиваются хэппи-эндом, но, тем не менее, они будут интересны самому широкому кругу зрителей: от самых маленьких до людей в возрасте. Сюжет фильма обычно предполагает некое размышление или обсуждение, потому что он поднимает важные философские вопросы, заставляет задуматься о понятиях "любовь", "дружба", "верность", "предательство". Помимо главной мелодраматической линии отношений героев, фильмы из подборки "Семейных мелодрам" содержат и философский, и морально-нравственный подтекст, и авторскую позицию по ключевым вопросам бытия. Вместе с тем, это не нудное поучительное рассуждение. Ленты также повествуют о личном выборе героя в сложных жизненных обстоятельствах, которые будут близки всем зрителям.

programme.desc: Это не выдуманные истории, а реконструкция реальных событий, которые могут случиться с каждой семьей. programme.title: Modigliani
programme.desc: American drama, produced in 2004. An American, French, German, Italian, Rumanian, and British co-production. The story of Amedeo Modigliani's bitter rivalry with Pablo Picasso, and his tragic romance with Jeanne Hebuterne.

programme.title: The Good Girl
programme.desc: A discount store clerk strikes up an affair with a stock boy who considers himself the incarnation of Holden Caulfield.Justine is a sullen 30-year-old woman stuck in a dead-end job at the Retail Rodeo department store.In addition to her mind-numbing occupation, Justine also has to contend with her dim-witted husband, Phil, and his partner, Bubba, who work as house painters when they aren't smoking pot and staring blankly at the television.Justine sees an opportunity for change, however, when she meets Holden, a fellow Retail Rodeo employee who is even more depressed than herself.The young Holden and Justine soon begin a passionate secret affair, unaware that it may not be so secret after all.

programme.title: The Recall
programme.desc: The great Wesley Snipes (Blade himself!) stars as "The Hunter" in this Mauro Borrelli (The Ghostmaker) directed film. The Recall also stars RJ Mitte (Breaking Bad), Jedidiah Goodacre (Descendants), Niko Pepaj (Awkward), Laura Maria Bilgeri (Toby Goes to Camp) and Hannah Rose May (Ballers). The movie tells the tale of five friends vacationing at a remote lake house, expecting nothing less than a good time. Unbeknownst to them, Earth is under an alien invasion and in the thralls of a mass-abduction. Director Borelli is a former collaborator of director Tim Burton and the film illustrator for blockbuster films such as Pirates of the Caribbean and Captain America. The Recall will also be shot for the new Barco Escape three-screen, panoramic theatrical format, which fully surrounds audiences and offers the ultimate immersive cinema experience. Portions of the films will also be shot in Virtual Reality.

programme.title: The Waiting
programme.desc: Jean Barreau leads a spiritual commune on the countryside with the promise of a second life. When their doubles arrive at the house, his followers learn that Jean meant this promise quite literally. However, not everybody is as easily swayed by their capricious leader, who eventually starts to question his own beliefs.

programme.title: Corner Office
programme.desc: Orson, a compulsive bureaucrat who discovers a secret room.

programme.title: Lost Treasure of Jesse James
programme.desc: A backwoods team of Missouri kids race to solve a 100 year old mystery and save their friends in this family friendly action adventure. Chased deep into ancient caves they must escape treasure hunters hot on their trail or be lost forever.

programme.title: The Lucky Dragon
programme.desc: A young, Chinese dragon punished by the gods to be a mere mortal is cast down to earth. He is forced to make his way in a strange land until the evil forces discover his true identity. Take part in a world full of imagination while following the journey of a mischievous dragon who has been transformed by magic into a little boy and exiled from his home to live among humans. When both good and evil forces learn that a dragon has arrived, they look for him as he is the only one who can find the magical sword—whose owner can rule the universe! Will he find the sword in time before it gets into the wrong hands? Will he ever become a dragon again?

programme.title: No Limit Kids
programme.desc: Ashton, Celeste, and Becca are three unlikely middle school outcasts who form a club in an abandoned theater. There, they meet Charlie (Bill Cobbs, Night at the Museum), a homeless man who shares their passion for musical theater. When the theater is scheduled to be torn down, the teenagers set out to save the landmark with a modern-day performance of Shakespeare's Much Ado About Nothing. Along the way, the group learns to treat others with respect and stand up for their beliefs. This Dove-approved film also features Emmy and Golden Globe nominee Lee Meriwether.

programme.title: Prince and Me 2: The Royal Wedding
programme.desc: The Prince and Me 2: The Royal Wedding continues the story of 2003's fantasy romance The Prince and Me. In the earlier film, Paige (Julia Stiles) - a midwestern college co-ed - falls in love with Edvard (Luke Mably), sans realizing that he is actually the Prince of Denmark. In this sequel, Paige (now played by neophyte Kam Heskin) and Eddie must confront a centuries-old Danish edict declaring that if a Danish prince marries a commoner, he must abdicate his throne. C

programme.title: My Dad's Christmas Date
programme.desc: Ever since his wife died, David struggles to get on with his teenage daughter Jules. She feels hemmed in and misunderstood, and he finds himself more and more powerless and lonely. In order to find a new partner for her dad and someone to talk to for herself, Jules creates online profiles on dating sites for David. Things suddenly take a funny turn, because although there is no shortage of candidates, they all fall short of David's ... and Jules's expectations. Will everything take a fresh turn on Christmas? A funny, heartwarming story in a wonderful Xmas mood!

programme.title: Mayor Cupcake
programme.desc: A hard-working cupcake maker is inadvertently elected mayor of a small town burdened with debt. With no formal experience or education to speak of, she must rely on her street smarts to clean up the town.

programme.title: 10 Things We Should Do Before We Break Up
programme.desc: Abigail, a self-sufficient single mom meets Ben. They both think every great relationship ends in disaster. On the first date they come up with 10 things to do together before they break up. But the estimated end is not so sure - because fate adds #11 to their list.

programme.title: Max Cloud
programme.desc: A space cruiser crash lands on the purple planet of Heinous, an intergalactic prison that is home to the most vile and dangerous villains in the galaxy. All of the crew have perished except for its pilot; intergalactic space hero Max Cloud, the ships hapless chef Jake, and its reluctant Commander, Rexy. Their mission is simple, wait inside their vessel until help arrives and try their best to keep the prisoners outside from getting in, however this is Max Cloud and he doesn't do simple. ...But this is not real life. This is a video-game, and at the helm of the adventure is Sarah, a teenage video game fanatic who immerses herself in fantasy to avoid dealing with her less than packed social life and a strained relationship with her dad, straight laced single parent Tony. After a fallout, Tony bans Sarah from playing games and in a frenzy of teenage emotion Sarah makes a wish, that in the blink of an eye becomes a reality... With a flash of pixelated light Sarah is transported into the video game by the mysterious Space Witch, who exists in an etherial void, behind a secret door, that never appears in the same place twice! So Sarah finds herself trapped inside the game and the only person who can help her is her equally socially defunct but incredibly charming friend, Cowboy, who must control Sarah from her bedroom in Brooklyn and keep her from losing her one life, in a game that can't be paused, that they have never finished before! To make matters worse Sarah has not found herself inside the body of the wonderful Max Cloud, but Jake, that's right... the hapless chef. We follow Sarah as she negotiates the terrifying and dangerous planet of Heinous alongside the ever confident Max and fed up Rexy, jumping back and forth with the real world as the pressure mounts on Cowboy and the real stakes start to rise. They soon encounter stranded Bounty Hunter, Brock Donnelly, and realise they must get off the planet before help arrives as the planets surface burns so hot every day that anything not underground is space liquid! AND to add to the stakes Cowboy must keep his best friend away from the evil clutches of the games villain Revengor, a part man, part machine, lunatic who is hell bent on taking Max Clouds ship and with an army of prisoners and an evil sorcersss called SHEE, his chances look pretty damn good. The action bounces between the video game and the real world as Cowboy and Sarah must come together to get her home, all leading to the ultimate showdown in Revengors lair, where back in Brooklyn, video game expertise arrives in the form of a very unlikely hero. Sit down. Plug in. It's time to play THE INTERGALACTIC ADVENTURES OF MAX CLOUD.

programme.title: Headwinds
programme.desc: Sarah tells Paul that she wants out of their marriage; the next day she disappears. A year later and Paul along with their children return to his childhood town to start anew after the loss of his wife and their mother.

programme.title: Remembrance
programme.desc: Remembrance depicts a remarkable love story that blossomed amidst the terror of a German concentration camp in 1944 Poland. This impossible passion fuels the courage of a Polish prisoner who manages to rescue his Jewish girlfriend. Against all odds, they escape the camp and survive a treacherous journey to freedom. But during the chaos of the end of the war, they are forcibly separated and each is convinced that the other has died. More than thirty years later in New York, the happily married 52-year-old woman accidentally finds out that her former Polish lover is still alive. And she has to see him again.

programme.title: When Do We Eat?
programme.desc: A family's Passover gets screwy after the patriarch unknowingly ingests a hit of Ecstasy.

programme.title: The Flock
programme.desc: This film is about a hyper-vigilant employee of the department of public safety who, while training his young female replacement, has to track down a missing girl who he is convinced is connected to a paroled sex offender he is investigating.

programme.title: The Humanity Bureau
programme.desc: In the near future, war, climate and political agendas have robbed America of its lush resources. Seeds rarely grow into vegetation, the water is mostly polluted, and people are obligated to work hard to earn their keep. Noah Kross (Nicolas Cage) is an agent of "the Humanity Bureau," a government agency that determines a person's productivity. Kross's reports are key factors in deciding who stays in America and who is deported to New Eden. Kross is in charge of managing the deportation of a former governor of Colorado who now lives in misery, who claims to know "the truth" before seeking to kill Kross and then being shot by him. Kross ends up discovering that New Eden is really an extermination camp where the excess unproductive population is liquidated and incinerated.

programme.title: Miss Nobody
programme.desc: Unlucky in love, living at home with her eccentric mom, and stuck in a dead end secretarial job at Judge Pharmaceuticals, Sarah Jane longs for more out of life. Her surprise promotion to junior executive appears to be just the ticket. But with promotion comes a competitive new world of wily, complicated executives, and Sarah Jane begins to eliminate the competition the only way she knows how - murder. During her climb to the top, she unexpectedly falls for the man of her dreams, Detective Bill Malloy - the cop intent on cracking the case of the mysterious deaths at Judge Pharmaceuticals.

programme.title: The Sandman
programme.desc: One fine morning, Benno finds sand in his bed. While he tries to ignore this at first, he soon must realize that he himself is loosing the sand. Day after day the sand increases and soon his time literally starts running short. Finally he is left no choice but to ask Sandra for help, who runs a small coffee shop under his apartment. Although Benno hates her with a passion, he started having dreams of her every night. What could Sandra and the dreams have to do with the sand?

programme.title: McCinsey's Island
programme.desc: A former secret agent finds a treasure map and decides to find the loot. But he is not the only one.

programme.title: The Adventure Scouts
programme.desc: A coming of age movie about a group of boys and girls called "adventure scouts" who return from a camping trip to discover their small town is being held captive by a gang of motorcycle-riding knuckleheads. Using only their scouting knowledge and camping equipment, the kids take down the gang members one by one, reunite with family members, and restore the community's sense of pride.

programme.title: Uncle Nino
programme.desc: A distant, slightly dysfunctional family is brought closer together when the father's long-estranged Uncle Nino comes from Italy to Chicago for a surprise visit.

programme.title: Baba
programme.desc: An weird but witty old woman is forced to deal with an ambiguous future after her country, family and the entire system of values are ruined. She is trying to solve her existential problems catching d trying to sell a rewarded war criminal as he was a rabbit in a wood. The only thing she did not know if he is really him.

programme.title: The Ambassador to Bern
programme.desc: Attila Szasz's political thriller portraying the events of the hostage taking of the Hungarian ambassador to Switzerland in the aftermath of the 1956 Hungarian Revolution. The film was presented at numerous festivals all over the world. It won the Frederico Fellini Award at Tiburon International Film Festival.

programme.title: Decembers
programme.desc: The ghost of a photojournalist killed during the American invasion of Panama in December 1989 returns exactly ten years later to resolve family conflicts.

programme.title: Irish Jam
programme.desc: A South Central L.A. con artist with rap skills tries to keep bill collectors and his lover, with marriage in mind, at bay by entering a poetry contest staged by a small Irish town. Can his rhyming skills help the town and win him the prize money?

programme.title: Con Man
programme.desc: The story of Barry Minkow, a young charismatic business man who becomes a wealthy CEO by lying, cheating and stealing his way to the top.

programme.title: Crown Vic
programme.desc: A night patrol in L.A. with veteran officer Ray Mandel and ambitious rookie Nick Holland takes an unexpected turn. In order to control the gangs fighting them they'll need much more than the Crown Victoria police cruiser.

programme.title: Black Cop
programme.desc: A black police officer gets pushed to the edge after he is profiled and assaulted by the colleagues he worked side by side with, so he decides to get revenge and take his frustrations out on the community that he swore to protect.

programme.title: The Groomsmen
programme.desc: A 30-something man decides to marry his pregnant girlfriend and asks his four best friends to stand with him at the wedding, but as he observes his friends relationship troubles, he wrestles with issues of fatherhood, marriage and growing up.

programme.title: The Tournament
programme.desc: Every ten years in an unsuspecting town, The Tournament takes place. A battle royale between 40 of the world's deadliest assassins. The last man standing receiving the $10,000,000 cash prize and the title of Worlds No1, which itself carries the legendary million dollar a bullet price tag. All fights are monitored 24hrs a day on redirected CCTV cameras and broadcast secretly to a ring of high stake billionaire gamblers. A gritty, multistranded action-thriller, The Tournament brings together international killers from every imaginable discipline in a blood-bathed contest to the death. We follow the competition favourites through stories of love, betrayal, revenge and redemption as they finally discover the true value of life

programme.title: The 51st State
programme.desc: In Ronny Yu's fast-moving crime-thriller, Samuel L Jackson plays Elmo McElroy, a pharmaceutical genius who has made a fortune in illegal drugs, particularly with Formula 51, which is more potent than heroin and crack. But instead of selling it to his drug lord employer the Lizard (Meatloaf), he flies to Liverpool where Felix (Robert Carlyle) is acting as broker for gangster Leopold Durant (Ricky Tomlinson). Durant is prepared to offer $20m for the formula; money Elmo would love to spend, if he can stay alive long enough.

programme.title: Ķeceris
programme.desc: Divas jaunas misionāru meitenes klauvē pie kādas mājas durvīm. Tās atver omulīgais misters Rīds, kurš viņas aicina iekšā. Ātri vien meitenes apjēdz, ka nokļuvušas velnišķīgā slazdā un šī ir spēle uz dzīvību un nāvi.

programme.title: Patriotu diena
programme.desc: Režisors: Pīters Bergs. Lomās: Marks Vālbergs, Džons Gudmens, Kevins Bēkons, Mišela Monegana, Dž. K. Simonss, Alekss Volfs, Temo Melikadze, Melisa Benuā. Filmas pamatā ir traģiskie notikumi Bostonas maratonā 2013. gadā. Uzreiz pēc sprādzieniem policijas seržants Tomijs Sonderss un FIB aģentu komanda uzsāka teroristu meklēšanu. Brāļu Carnajevu notveršana izrādījās viena no sarežģītākajām un spraigākajām operācijām policijas vēsturē. Režisors Pīters Bergs un aktieris Marks Vālbergs rekonstruējuši teroristu nodomus un to realizāciju, kas izdzēsa vairākas dzīvības un sakustināja iluzorās drošības pamatus. Patriotu diena ir viena no ASV Austrumu krasta oficiālajām brīvdienām, un kopš 1969. gada Masačūsetsas štatā to atzīmē aprīļa trešajā pirmdienā. Tās nozīmīgākais notikums ir Bostonas maratons, kam ir vairāk nekā 100 gadus senas saknes, un 2013. gadā tas pārvērtās par slaktiņu, ko pirms finiša līnijas noorganizēja divi Kirgizstānā dzimuši brāļi. Divus gadus pēc Bostonas maratona traģēdijas rakstnieks Keisijs Šērmens un Bostonas žurnālists Deivs Vedžs izdeva grāmatu, kas atklāja 2013. gada aprīļa notikumus. Tā kļuvusi par pamatu scenārijam, kas pārvērsts asa sižeta trillerī ar Marku Vālbergu, Džonu Gudmenu, Kevinu Bēkonu, Dž. K. Simonsu un Mišelu Monegani galvenajās lomās.

programme.title: Sirds robeža
programme.desc: Dziedātājs. Nemiernieks. Izraidītais. Varonis. Džonijs Kešs. Ar tik smagiem akordiem, kas spētu aizkustināt pat kravas vilcienu, tēraudpelēko acu intensīvo skatienu un balsi, tumšu kā nakts, leģendārais "Vīrs melnā" sarīkoja mūzikā revolūciju un pats radīja savu īstas amerikāņu leģendas imidžu. Būdams cilvēks, kura dzīvi vada spēcīgas kaislības, Džonijs Kešs nekad neatteicās no savas kontraversālās personības. Savas karjeras sākumā viņš satika vienīgo patieso savu mūža mīlestību Džūnu Kārteri, kas spēja viņu glābt no sevis paša.

programme.title: Ķeceris
programme.desc: Divas jaunas misionāru meitenes klauvē pie kādas mājas durvīm. Tās atver omulīgais misters Rīds, kurš viņas aicina iekšā. Ātri vien meitenes apjēdz, ka nokļuvušas velnišķīgā slazdā un šī ir spēle uz dzīvību un nāvi.

programme.title: Patvērums
programme.desc: Kērtiss Laforšs kopā ar sievu Samantu un nedzirdīgo meitiņu Hannu dzīvo nelielā Ohaio pilsētā. Naudas ir maz, turklāt Hannai ir nepieciešama īpaša medicīniskā aprūpe un izglītība. Tomēr par spīti visam Kērtiss un Samanta mīl viens otru, un visi kopā viņi ir laimīga ģimene. Kad Kērtiss redz šausminošus sapņus par katastrofālus plūdus nesošu vētru, viņš nolemj mazināt satraukumu, ceļot patvertni ģimenes mājas pagalmā. Rezultātā sarežģās viņa attiecības ar sievu.

programme.title: Apokalipto
programme.desc: Maiju valstībai piedzīvojot tās norietu, jauns vīrietis dodas bīstamā ceļojumā uz pasauli, kurā valda bailes un apspiešana.

programme.title: Neiespējamais
programme.desc: Jūens Makgregors un Naomi Votsa aizkustinošā filmā, kas uzņemta, balstoties uz patiesiem notikumiem par ģimeni, kas atradās 2004. gada postošā cunami pašā tā epicentrā Taizemē. Šis cunami atzīts par vispostošāko dabas katastrofu modernajā vēsturē. Marija, Henrijs un viņu trīs dēli dodas svinēt Ziemassvētkus Taizemē. 26. decembra rītā pār piekrasti veļas ūdens siena, kas savā ceļā aizskalo visu. Neticamā veidā ģimene izdzīvo, taču cunami viņus nošķir vienu no otra. Starp postījumiem, sāpēm un izmisumu viņiem ir jāpaveic neiespējamais - jāatrod vienam otru...

programme.desc: Kērtiss Laforšs kopā ar sievu Samantu un nedzirdīgo meitiņu Hannu dzīvo nelielā Ohaio pilsētā. Naudas ir maz, turklāt Hannai ir nepieciešama īpaša medicīniskā aprūpe un izglītība. Tomēr par spīti visam Kērtiss un Samanta mīl viens otru, un visi kopā viņi ir laimīga ģimene. Kad Kērtiss redz šausminošus sapņus par katastrofālus plūdus nesošu vētru, viņš nolemj mazināt satraukumu, ceļot patvertni ģimenes mājas pagalmā. Rezultātā sarežģās viņa attiecības ar sievu.

programme.title: A komanda
programme.desc: Seriāls stāsta par četriem bijušajiem ASV armijas specvienības karavīriem, kuri, netaisnīgi apsūdzēti noziegumā, bēg no militārās policijas un palīdz cilvēkiem, kuri nonākuši nelaimē.

programme.title: Apokalipto
programme.desc: Maiju valstībai piedzīvojot tās norietu, jauns vīrietis dodas bīstamā ceļojumā uz pasauli, kurā valda bailes un apspiešana.

programme.title: Neiespējamais
programme.desc: Jūens Makgregors un Naomi Votsa aizkustinošā filmā, kas uzņemta, balstoties uz patiesiem notikumiem par ģimeni, kas atradās 2004. gada postošā cunami pašā tā epicentrā Taizemē. Šis cunami atzīts par vispostošāko dabas katastrofu modernajā vēsturē. Marija, Henrijs un viņu trīs dēli dodas svinēt Ziemassvētkus Taizemē. 26. decembra rītā pār piekrasti veļas ūdens siena, kas savā ceļā aizskalo visu. Neticamā veidā ģimene izdzīvo, taču cunami viņus nošķir vienu no otra. Starp postījumiem, sāpēm un izmisumu viņiem ir jāpaveic neiespējamais - jāatrod vienam otru...

programme.title: Asfalta pilsēta
programme.desc: Ollijs Kross ir jauns feldšeris, kurš strādā Ņujorkas nakts maiņā kopā ar pieredzējušu un nelokāmu partneri Džīnu Rutkovski. Katrs 911 izsaukums bieži ir bīstams un neparedzams, ik dienu liekot viņu dzīvības uz spēles, lai palīdzētu citiem.

programme.title: Nemirstīgie
programme.desc: Apsēsts ar valdītkāri, karalis Hiperions grib iznīcināt cilvēku rasi un gāzt Olimpa dievus, kuri ir bezspēcīgi pretoties viņam. Šim nolūkam viņš atbrīvo Titānus no tūkstošgadu ieslodzījuma. Vienīgā cerība uz pestīšanu ir varonis Tēsejs. Nāvīgā cīņā ar Titāniem varoni atbalsta praviete Fedra, vergs Stavros un pats Zevs, bet šķiet, ka Hiperiona spēks ir neuzvarams. Vai Olimpa dievi tiks gāzti?

programme.title: Spartaks
programme.desc: Pēc veiksmīgas gladiatoru izbēgšanas Spartaks vada atbrīvoto vergu armiju, vienlaikus izvēloties starp personīgo atriebību pret Romas ģenerāli Glāberu un cīņu par brīvību.

programme.title: Mans puisis - slepkava
programme.desc: Pēc sava drauga pieķeršanas neuzticībā, Marta kļūst mazliet neprātīga. Bet tad viņa iepazīstas ar Frānsisu. Viņš škiet īstais, ideālais vīrtietis, ja vien.. viņš nebūtu profesionāls slepkava. Kad Marta sāk apjaust, ka viņas jaunais puisis nejoko, sacīdams "es iziešu ārā, lai kādu novāktu", lietas kļūst vēl sarežģītākas. Izrādās Frānsisu vajā kriminālie grupēji, kas ir arī viņa iepriekšējie darba devēji. Līķiem krājoties kaudzē, Martai jāizlemj vai viņa grib bēg ko kājas nes vai kļūt par cienīgu partneri savam pusim-slepkavam.

programme.title: Neatklātie ieraksti
programme.desc: Rozannai jeb Rozai pēc 50 gadiem ir jāpamet psihiatriskā klīnika, ko sieviete sauc par mājām visus šos gadus. Roza atsakās vietu pamest. Kad pie viņas ierodas ārsts Viljams Grīns, viņš uzzina, ka Roza piekopj savādus ikdienas rituālus un ilgus gadus rakstījusi dienasgrāmatu ar kodētiem ierakstiem. Jaunā Roza Otrā pasaules kara laikā ir zaudējusi savu māti un negaidīti iemīlas lidotājā. Tomēr Rozu pašu nolūkojis vietējais priesteris. Savstarpējās attiecības kļūst sarežģītas. Pēc daudziem gadiem slēptā patiesība pamazām atklājas Rozas dienasgrāmatu ierakstos. Galvenās lomas atveidotāja ir Rūnija Mara, amerikāņu aktrise, divu "Oskara" balvu nominante, arī viņas māsa Keita Mara ir aktrise un popularitāti guva ar Zojas lomu politiskajā detektīvseriālā "Kāršu namiņš" kopā ar Kevinu Speisiju un Robinu Raitu. Rūnija Mara atveidojusi lomas tādās filmās kā "Meitene ar pūķa tetovējumu", "Blakusefekts", "Kerola". Īru režisors Džims Šeridans ir veidojis tādas filmas kā "Mana kreisā kāja", "Brāļi", "Bokseris". Karjeras laikā nominēts sešiem "Oskariem" kā labākais režisors un scenārija autors. Lomās: Rūnija Mara, Vanesa Redgreiva, Teo Džeimss, Eidans Tērners, un citi. Rež: Džims Šeridans

programme.title: Ideālā Ferdinanda Čevala pils
programme.desc: Ševals ir pastnieks, kurš katru dienu ceļo pa Dromas upes apkārtni. Viņš satiek savas dzīves īsto sievieti Filomenu, un no viņu savienības piedzimst Alise. Tad viņš metas trakā azartspēlē: savām rokām uzcelt viņai neticamu pili.

programme.title: Bruklina
programme.desc: 1951. gada beigās Eilisa Leisija (Sīrša Ronana) pamet Īriju un dodas uz Bruklinu, lai sāktu jaunu dzīvi, atbalstot savu ģimeni. Viņai palīdz tēvs Flads, un Eilisa drīz nonāk dzīves ritenī, strādājot universālveikalā un studējot grāmatvedību. Kad viņa saskatās ar itāļu izcelsmes amerikāņu santehniķi, viņa saprot, ka ir pilnībā iemīlējusies. Taču pēc traģiska negadījuma viņai jādodas atpakaļ mājās, kur atjauno saites ar bijušajiem draugiem un mēģina izprast, kur veidot savu dzīvi tālāk.

programme.title: Viena dzīvība
programme.desc: Stāsts par parastu cilvēku - britu mākleri Nikolasu Vintonu, kurš Otrā pasaules kara priekšvakarā palīdzēja izglābt simtiem Čehoslovākijas bērnu no nacistu iebrukuma. Piecdesmit gadus vēlāk, 1988. gadā, Nikiju joprojām vajā to bērnu liktenis, kurus viņš nebija spējis evakuēt uz Angliju. Līdz kādā BBC televīzijas raidījuma tiešraidē viņš tiek iepazīstināts ar dažiem no izdzīvojušajiem, tagad jau pieaugušajiem bērniem, un viņš beidzot sāk mācīties sev piedot.

programme.title: Teikuma beigas
programme.desc: Pēc atbrīvošanas no cietuma jauns vīrietis negribīgi dodas ceļojumā kopā ar savu atsvešināto tēvu, lai izkaisītu mātes pelnus viņas dzimtajā Īrijā.

programme.title: Visa pasaules nauda
programme.desc: Kad sešpadsmitgadīgais Džons Pols Getijs III tiek nolaupīts, viņa izmisusī māte Geila lūdz jaunekļa vectēvu, naftas magnātu, samaksāt izpirkumu. Kad miljardieris Getijs atsakās, Geila visiem spēkiem mēģina viņu pārliecināt, jo dēla nolaupītāji kļūst arvien brutālāki. Kamēr zēna dzīvība karājas mata galā, negaidīti par Geilas sabiedroto šajā cīņā kļūst Getija konsultants Flečers Čeiss, bijušais CIP darbinieks.

programme.desc: Vīrieti sāk vajāt pagātne - viņš saņem noslēpumainu mantojumu, kas liek viņam pārdomāt savu pašreizējo dzīves situāciju.

programme.title: Adelainas gadi
programme.desc: Jaunā Adelaina, būdama vien 29 gadus veca, iekļūst autoavārijā, pēc kuras iegūst spēju nenovecot. Stāsts turpinās par viņu nu jau 80 gadu vecumā, Adelaina dzīvo vientulībā un noslēgtībā, neļaujot sevi ietekmēt apkārtējai pasaulei. Adelainas meita ir vienīgā, kura zina viņas noslēpumu. Pēc ilgajiem gadiem Adelaina sastop vīrieti, ar kuru kopā vēlētos novecot. Viņa atkal vēlas dzīvot un mīlēt, taču brīdī, kad viņas noslēpumu varētu atklāt, Adelaina pieņem lēmumu, kas izmainīs viņas dzīvi.

programme.title: Laiks aiziet
programme.desc: Modes fotogrāfs ar neārstējamu vēzi izvēlas mirt viens, sagatavojot citus dzīvot pēc viņa, nevis paildzināt neizbēgamo ar ķīmijterapiju vai ļauties līdzjūtībai no tiem, kas viņu pazīst.

programme.title: 100 Cooks
programme.desc: It is the biggest home cook competition of all time. Actor, television host and former pro football player Terry Crews hosts as 100 of America's elite home cooks enter the stadium kitchen arena where they will be challenged to the most unpredictable, professional-chef level cooking competition ever. As the competition begins, chefs are selected at random to come to the floor to compete while the "Challenge Mixer" dictates the challenges they will face ranging from fast-paced trivia contests to 30-minute do-or-die cooking battles. Top culinary content creator Nick DiGiovanni and chef and NYT best-selling cookbook author Alex Guarnaschelli are the judges that determine who stays and who goes. Each round's winner will be given a chance to take the cash or add it to the ever-growing grand prize pot, which starts at $100,000...so as the number of cooks goes down, the grand prize goes up.

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: In Granada, Mississippi, the owner of the failing 333 Restaurant, Allyson, is busy teaching art full-time but still forces the restaurant's manager to contact her before making any decision, big or small. Left without a leader, the chaotic restaurant is just months from shutting its doors. Since Allyson won't give up teaching, Robert Irvine must convince her that trusting and empowering her staff is the only way she can save her restaurant.

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: Robert Irvine heads to Shreveport, Louisiana, to meet Mavice, the owner of her father's legacy restaurant, Eddie's. The seafood spot is best known for its famous stuffed shrimp, but neither the signature dish nor the restaurant are what they used to be. Mavice's stubborn refusal to adapt is running the food, finances and family into the ground. Robert must convince Mavice to make the changes necessary to save her family's legacy and their livelihood.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods
programme.desc: Travel and cuisine documentary series, hosted by famous Andrew Zimmern, American culinary expert, chef, restaurateur and television personality and spin-off series of ''Bizarre Foods'', focuses on classic, iconic foods (not bizarre like in the original series) from some well-known destinations- moussaka and real Greek yogurt from Athens, sweet macarons and crepes from Paris, Italian gelato, gooey fondue to Swiss chocolate from Zurich, mile-high pastrami sandwiches and bagels from NYC, and many other legendary foods. The show will explore where these dishes came from, how they're prepared, and the best way to enjoy them. Andrew will also discover some secrets and interesting stories behind these epic meals.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: Chopped is an American reality cooking TV game show hosted by Ted Allen. Four chefs compete against each other. At the beginning of each round they receive a basket containing four mystery ingredients and are expected to create the best three-course meal using every single one of them. Each round has a time limit. The dishes are judged based on their presentation, taste and creativity. At the end of every round one chef is "chopped" from the competition with no prize. The winner can get up to $50.000.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives is American food reality television series about places with the most delicious food. The host is American restaurateur Guy Fieri who travels along the USA, Canada or Europe looking for the most fascinating cafes and introduces them to the viewers. Each show has a specific focus on a certain dish, like burgers, pasta, comfort food. Small cafes with traditional food and home-style recipes or ethnic specialties adored by the locals are of particular interest to the host. Guy Fieri enters the kitchen, gets to know the cook, actively takes part in cooking, interacts with the guests and kitchen staff and gives his humorous spicy comments on the process and the food itself.

programme.desc: Join our hosts, renowned celebrity chefs and restaurateurs Bobby Flay and Michael Symon, as they test the skills of eight expert barbecue connoisseurs. Filmed at the Star Hill Ranch in Austin, Texas, the eight chefs are divided into two teams but, in order to claim first pick for their team, Bobby and Michael go head-to-head in a backyard BBQ challenge. programme.title: 100 Cooks
programme.desc: It is the biggest home cook competition of all time. Actor, television host and former pro football player Terry Crews hosts as 100 of America's elite home cooks enter the stadium kitchen arena where they will be challenged to the most unpredictable, professional-chef level cooking competition ever. As the competition begins, chefs are selected at random to come to the floor to compete while the "Challenge Mixer" dictates the challenges they will face ranging from fast-paced trivia contests to 30-minute do-or-die cooking battles. Top culinary content creator Nick DiGiovanni and chef and NYT best-selling cookbook author Alex Guarnaschelli are the judges that determine who stays and who goes. Each round's winner will be given a chance to take the cash or add it to the ever-growing grand prize pot, which starts at $100,000...so as the number of cooks goes down, the grand prize goes up.

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: After combating countless "impossible dinners," Chef Robert Irvine faces a daunting new challenge: save America's most desperate restaurants from impending failure in just two days with only $10,000. In his new prime-time Food Network series, Restaurant: Impossible, Robert uses creativity and resourcefulness along with a lot of muscle in his fight to rescue these restaurants and give hope to the owners and their employees. Day one of the extreme mission begins with a thorough business assessment as Robert launches the restaurant into full service, closely observes the staff and kitchen, and determines their weakest spots. Then, he springs into action by updating the menu, retraining the staff and implementing aesthetic changes with the help of his design team. To ensure a packed house for the grand re-opening at the end of day two, Robert hits the streets to tell the community about the improved restaurant. Will the ruthless schedule, tight budget and ambitious task overcome Robert's lofty goals, or will this tall order result in restaurant triumph?

programme.title: Bobby's Triple Threat
programme.desc: Tournament of Champions winner Chef Mei Lin brings her competitive edge to Bobby Flay's Triple Threat kitchen. As Michael Voltaggio's former protege, she's ready to show that the student can outcook the master and the rest of team Titan. Then, judge Stephanie Izard will decide if Mei Lin's winning streak has come to an end.

programme.title: Bobby and Giada in Italy
programme.desc: While Rome is a city steeped in tradition, the food scene is being updated with modern techniques and new flavor combinations. From pizza pies inspired by famous pastas to a trendy food market, Bobby Flay and Giada De Laurentiis explore how the food culture is evolving while still honoring the classics. Plus, they cook up some cutting-edge cuisine with a local Michelin star chef.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods
programme.desc: Travel and cuisine documentary series, hosted by famous Andrew Zimmern, American culinary expert, chef, restaurateur and television personality and spin-off series of ''Bizarre Foods'', focuses on classic, iconic foods (not bizarre like in the original series) from some well-known destinations- moussaka and real Greek yogurt from Athens, sweet macarons and crepes from Paris, Italian gelato, gooey fondue to Swiss chocolate from Zurich, mile-high pastrami sandwiches and bagels from NYC, and many other legendary foods. The show will explore where these dishes came from, how they're prepared, and the best way to enjoy them. Andrew will also discover some secrets and interesting stories behind these epic meals.

programme.title: It Should Not Had Happened
programme.desc: For every Ukrainian, everything that is happening in our country now is a horror. But there are those who should not experience this at all in the 21st century. Those who should not experience these terrible events in any way. These are children. Millions of Ukrainian children left their homes, said goodbye to their grandparents. Children left behind the toys they used to fall asleep with, playgrounds and parks where they loved to walk with their classmates. Stories of dozens of children from different parts of Ukraine who went through what no child in the world should go through.

programme.title: Yabluska Street
programme.desc: Yablunska Street " explores the tragedy of Bucha through the history of its "road of death", which became the epicenter of Russian atrocities and a symbol of the genocide of the Ukrainian people. The film is based on the testimonies of residents who survived the occupation, including those who miraculously survived executions and torture. The film documents in detail the consequences of the Bucha massacre, where on one street alone the occupiers massively killed civilians - from children to the elderly (in total, 637 victims were found in the city). The journalists managed not only to record the confessions of eyewitnesses, but also to conduct an investigation to establish the names of the dead and identify the war criminals responsible for these terrible murders.

programme.title: Brīvdienu draugi
programme.desc: Markuss brīvdienās Meksikā bildina savu draudzeni Emīliju, un, lai to nosvinētu, pāris Rons un Kaila uzaicina abus uz savu luksusa numuru. Vakars iekarst, un nākamajā rīta Markuss atceras vien to, ka viņam bija sekss ar Kailu. Dažus mēnešus vēlāk Markuss un Emīlija svin kāzas, kurās negaidīti ierodas arī viņu brīvdienu draugi. Kaila ir stāvoklī un apgalvo, ka Markusam ar to ir kāds sakars.

programme.title: Ķēriens
programme.desc: Romantisks jubilejas ceļojums uz nomaļu namiņu pārvēršas drūmā pieredzē, kad atklājas tumša klātbūtne, piespiežot pāri stāties pretī īpašuma biedējošajai pagātnei.

programme.title: Cits cilvēks
programme.desc: Kritiķu cildināta tumšā komēdija par topošu aktieri, kurš, lai pārveidotu savu izskatu, veic radikālu medicīnisku procedūru, bet jaunā seja ātri pārvērš viņa dzīvi murgā.

programme.title: Kritiķis
programme.desc: Sers Ians Makellens (Gredzenu Pavēlnieks) atveido ietekmīgu Londonas teātra kritiķi, kurš atriebības vārdā sapin šantāžas tīklus ar letālām sekām.

programme.title: Šreks: ilgi un laimīgi
programme.desc: Cilvēkēdājs Šreks jau uzveicis ļaunu pūķi, atbrīvojis skaistu princesi un izglābis sievas ģimenes pārvaldīto karaļvalsti, bet tagad, pēc visa piedzīvotā, Šreks sāk ilgoties pēc vecās, labās cilvēkēdāja dzīves, kad ciema iedzīvotāji no viņa baidījās, nevis prasīja autogrāfus. Tāpēc, nedomājot par sekām, zaļais milzis noslēdz vienošanos ar viltīgo Rumpelrūķi. Parakstot līgumu, Šreks attopas ačgārnā un greizā Tāltālajā. Lai glābtu draugus, atjaunotu kārtību savā pasaulē un atgūtu Fionu, Šrekam būs krietni jāpacīnās.

programme.title: Visu laiku labākais Ziemassvētku konkurss
programme.desc: Herdmanu bērni neapšaubāmi ir sliktākie bērni pasaules vēsturē. Viņi melo, zog, krāpjas, iebiedē un visā visumā terorizē savu nelielo kopienu. Tomēr šajos Ziemassvētkos viņi pārņems vietējās baznīcas konkursu – pavisam nejauši viņiem var izdoties mazajai pilsētiņai iemācīt Ziemassvētku patieso nozīmi.

programme.title: Mīlestība dejas ritmā
programme.desc: Talantīgā balerīna Bārlova nolēmusi īstenot savu sapni Amerikas mākslas svētnīcā Ņujorkā. Diemžēl iepazīšanās ar svētnīcas realitāti nav īpaši patīkama – pieredzējusī baleta pasniedzēja Oksana skaidri un gaiši pasaka: Bārlova vēl nav ne tuvu pilnībai. Norijusi krupi, meitene nepadodas un piedalās jaunas Brodvejas deju izrādes atlasē. Režisors Zanders pievērš uzmanību Bārlovai un izvēlas viņu mēģinājumiem. Pēc dažām dienām topošās izrādes kodolam pievienojas talantīgais pianists Čārlijs. Tāpat kā Bārlova, viņš ieradies Ņujorkā, lai īstenotu sapni. Puisim un meitenei rodas simpātijas vienam pret otru, bet Zanders nav vienaldzīgs pret meiteni. Bārlova drīz vien sapinas mīlas trīsstūrī. Izrādes mēģinājumi kļūst arvien intensīvāki, slodze aug, un ne Bārlovai, ne Čārlijam neatliek laika nekam citam. Darbs vaiga sviedros, nemitīgā spriedze, sāncenšu nodevība un cīņa bez kompromisiem prasa visus spēkus.

programme.title: Ledus laikmets 3: Dinozauru ēra
programme.desc: Filmu "Ledus laikmets" un "Ledus Laikmets 2" varoņi ir atgriezušies - gatavi jauniem piedzīvojumiem. Skrets joprojām nododas nenotveramās zīles medībām. Menijs un Elija gaida mazuļa piedzimšanu, sliņķis Sids mēģina iztēloties ģimenes dzīvi, rūpējoties par nočieptām dinozaura olām, bet zobenzobu tīģeris Djego apsver, vai viņš nav kļuvis pārāk mīkstčaulīgs, tik daudz laika pavadot draugu kompānijā. Dodoties glābt nelaimē nokļuvušo Sidu, draugi nokļūst neparastā pazemes pasaulē, kur aci pret aci sastopas ar dinozauriem un ir spiesti cīnīties gan ar zvēriem, gan augiem.

programme.title: Varenais Ričards
programme.desc: Zvirbulis Ričijs kopš dzimšanas pieņemts stārķu ģimenē, visi viņu ļoti mīl, viņš ātri aug un jūtas kā īsts stārķis. Taču gājputniem stārķiem pienāk laiks lidot uz Āfriku, lai tur ziemotu. Ģimene ir spiesta atklāt Ričijam viņa izcelšanos, jo lidot kopā nedrīkst – grūtajā ceļojumā zvirbulis var iet bojā. Drosminieks negrasās nolaist spārnus un nolemj visiem pierādīt, ka ir īsts stārķis. Ričijs viens pats dodas ceļā, un viņam pievienojas jauni draugi – pūce Olga un papagailis Kiki.

programme.title: Mīluļu slepenā dzīve
programme.desc: Makss (Luiss Sīkejs) ir enerģisks un sajūsmināts Džeka Rasela terjers, kurš dzīvo Manhetenas dzīvoklī kopā ar īpašnieci Keitiju (Elija Kempere). Taču viņa laimīgā dzīve pārtrūkst, kad saimniece pieņem jaunu suni Grāfu (Ēriks Stounstrīts). Makss apņemas atgūt saimnieces uzmanību tikai sev un mēģina Grāfu atstāt kādā sānielā, taču viņus ielenc kaķu banda, kuru vada Ozons (Stīvs Kūgans). Viņi tik tikko izglābj savas dzīvības, kad nākas saskarties ar pamesto dzīvnieku armijas niknumu apburošā, bet psihiski nelīdzsvarotā truša Sniegapikas (Kevins Hārts) vadībā. Šis ir Ņujorkas piedzīvojums, kurš liek Maksam un Grāfam izvērtēt savu sacensību un mēģināt izjaukt Sniegapikas atriebes plānu pret visiem dzīvnieku īpašniekiem Ņujorkā.

programme.title: Pasažieri
programme.desc: Kosmiskais kuģis ar pieciem tūkstošiem pasažieru, kuri ir iegremdēti mākslīgajā sapnī, ceļo uz planētu, kas viņiem kļūs par jauno mājvietu. Negaidītas sistēmas kļūmes dēļ divi pasažieri Džims un Aurora pamostas ātrāk un saprot, ka līdz ceļojuma galapunktam vēl ir jālido 90 gadi, kas nozīmē, ka dzīves atlikušo daļu viņiem nāksies pavadīt divatā kosmiskā kuģa greznajā interjerā. Laiks skrien, un pakāpeniski viņi sajūt abpusējas simpātijas... Taču pēkšņi atklājas, ka kuģim draud briesmas...

programme.title: Viesnīca Transilvānija 3
programme.desc: Monstru ģimene šoreiz dodas brīvdienās. Luksusa kruīza kuģis aizvedīs Drakulu prom no rūpēm par viesnīcas apmeklētāju labsajūtu. Un kas ir atpūta bez draugiem, kuri tāpat ar prieku metas baudīt kuģa sniegtās izklaides! Taču, kad Drakula iemīlas noslēpumainajā kapteinē Ērikā, viņš vēl nenojauš, ka Ērika ir monstru lielākā ienaidnieka Ābrahama van Helsinga pēctece un sākas mošķu cienīga drāma.

programme.title: Gārfīlds
programme.desc: Pasaulslaveno pirmdienu nīdēju un lazanjas mīlētāju mājas kaķi Garfīldu gaida vājprātīgi jautrs piedzīvojums brīvā dabā! Negaidīti saticis savu sen zudušo tēvu, noplukušo ielas kaķi Viku, Gārfīlds kopā ar savu draugu, suni Odiju, ir spiests pamest ideālo lutekļa dzīvi un piebiedroties Vikam pārgalvīgā laupīšanā.

programme.title: Nabaga radības
programme.desc: Sava nežēlīgā vīra ietekmē Bella (Emma Stouna) ir izdarījusi pašnāvību, taču ekscentrisks zinātnieks (Vilems Defo) nolemj izglābt sievieti un pārstāda viņai pašas vēl nedzimušā bērna smadzenes. Viņa aizbildniecībā Bella alkst mācīties un iepazīt dzīvi, kas Viktorijas laikmeta stingrajā sabiedrībā viņai līdz šim bijusi liegta. Kopā ar viltīgo un valdzinoši cinisko juristu Dankanu Vederbērnu viņa dodas ceļojumā pāri kontinentiem. Ceļojuma laikā Bella arvien vairāk atbrīvojas no sava laikmeta aizspriedumiem un sabiedrības ierobežojumiem.

programme.title: Grenlande. Migrācija
programme.desc: Izdzīvojusi Grenlandes bunkurā, Garitiju ģimene dodas pāri sagrautai Eiropai, lai atrastu jaunas mājas.

programme.title: Lemāna-'66: Lielais izaicinājums
programme.desc: Filmas sižets balstīts patiesos notikumus un atgādina par autosporta vēstures spriedzes pilnām lapaspusēm. Notikumi risinās 60. gados, kad konstruktoru grupa, kuru vadīja Kerols Šelbijs, kopā ar britu sacīkšu braucēju Kenu Mailsu uzbūvēja vēl nebijušu "Ford" sporta automašīnu un meta izaicinājumu Lemānas 24 stundu sacīkšu favorītam "Ferrari".

programme.title: Bestsellers
programme.desc: Untumains pensionēts rakstnieks negribīgi sāk piedalīties savas pēdējās grāmatas veicināšanas kampaņā, lai izpalīdzētu jaunai izdevējai.

programme.title: Kungfu panda
programme.desc: Pandumānija turpinās! Kļuvis par varoni, panda Po nu kopā ar saviem draugiem Tīģerieni, Dzērvi, Čūsku, Pērtiķi un Dievlūdzēju aizsargā dzimto ieleju un tās iemītniekus. Taču Po mierīgajai dzīvei tiek pielikts punkts brīdī, kad uzrodas ļaundaris, kurš, liekot lietā noslēpumainu spēku, grib pakļaut Ķīnu. Pandai kopā ar draugiem būs jādodas cauri visai Ķīnai, lai uzveiktu pretinieku.

programme.title: Šreks
programme.desc: Kādā tālā zemē ļaunais valdnieks izraida uz mežu visus pasaku varoņus, lai zeme būtu tikpat garlaicīga kā pats valdnieks. Lielā milža Šreka mājvieta pārtop par bēgļu nometni. Tāpēc viņš nolemj atrast bargo valdnieku un pārliecināt, lai viņš atļauj zemes iemītniekiem atgriezties mājās. Valdnieks piekrīt, bet ar vienu nosacījumu – Šrekam jāatrod un jāatved daiļā princese Fiona, kuru ļaunais valdnieks nolēmis apprecēt, lai kļūtu par karali. Filma dublēta latviešu valodā.

programme.title: Šreks
programme.desc: Princeses Fionas vecāki ielūdz savu meitu un viņas jauno vīru uz svinīgām pusdienām savā pilī. Taču karaļpāris ij nenojauš, kā izskatās jaunais znots un cik ļoti viņu mazā meitiņa ir pārvērtusies... Gan Fiona, gan viņas iemīļotais Šreks ir zaļi, milzīgi cilvēkēdāji! Vai jaunlaulātajiem ir kaut mazākās cerības iegūt pavalstnieku labvēlību?

programme.title: Ļaunā
programme.desc: Tas ir stāsts par Oza zemes raganām. Elfaba ir apkārtējo nesaprasta savas zaļās ādas krāsas dēļ un ir ceļā, lai atklātu savu patieso spēku. Glinda ir populāra un priviliģēta jauniete, kura vēl nav atklājusi savu patieso sirdi. Pēc tikšanās ar Oza zemes burvi viņu draudzība nonāk krustcelēs.

programme.title: Ledus laikmets: Lielā sadursme
programme.desc: Skreta (Kriss Vedžs) nepārtrauktie pūliņi noglabāt savu zīli liek viņam izraisīt negadījumu virkni, kuru rezultātā asteroīdi sāk traukties uz Zemi. Haoss liek Manijam (Rejs Romano), Djego (Deniss Līrijs), Sidam (Džons Legvizamo) un viņu ģimenēm meklēt patvērumu. Piedzīvojumu meklētāja zebiekste Baks (Saimons Pegs) viņus brīdina, ka var sākties masveida izmiršana, kas liek draugiem meklēt jaunu mājvietu, pa ceļam satiekot citus dzīvniekus un apmeklējot eksotiskas vietas.

programme.title: Zirnekļcilvēks: Ceļojums Zirnekļpasaulē
programme.desc: Fils Lords un Kristofers Millers, radošie prāti aiz "Lego filma" un "Džampstrīta 21", apvieno savus talantus un pieņem izaicinājumu – radīt unikālu skatījumu par komiksu pasaulē labi zināmo Zirnekļcilvēka visumu. Viņiem tas izdodas ar elpu aizraujošu stāstu un līdz šim neredzētu vizuālo noformējumu, pelnīti saņemot Oskaru par gada labāko animācijas filmu. "Zirnekļcilvēks. Ceļojums Zirnekļpasaulē" mūs iepazīstina ar jauno Maiklu Moralesu un vēl pieciem spilgtiem personāžiem no dažādām dimensijām, kuri apveltīti ar zirnekļ-supervaroņa spējām. Tikai darbojoties kopā, viņi var apturēt briesmas, kas apdraud visas realitātes.

programme.title: Smurfi
programme.desc: Laipni lūdzam smurfu pasaulē! Burvis Gargamels ir piespiedis smurfus bēgt no dzimtā ciema. Ģimenes komēdija, kurā animācijas filmas varoņi parādās spēlfilmā.

programme.title: Parastie eņģeļi
programme.desc: Kentuki štata Luisvilā friziere Šērona Stīvensa pulcē ļaudis, lai palīdzētu par atraitni palikušajam tēvam Edam Šmitam izglābt viņa smagi slimo piecgadīgo meitu Mišelu. Viņu kopienu skārusi spēcīga sniega vētra, ko izraisīja 1994. gadā notikušais aukstuma vilnis Ziemeļamerikā.

programme.title: Pārgulēt, apprecēties, nogalināt
programme.desc: Sērijveida slepkava uzbrūk sievietēm randiņu lietotnēs, un Evas uzdevums ir noskaidrot, kurš no viņas randiņu puišiem ir potenciālais gultas partneris, iespējamais laulātais draugs un kurš plāno viņu nogalināt.

programme.title: Garā pastaiga
programme.desc: Grupa pusaudžu puišu sacenšas ikgadējās sacensībās, pazīstamās kā "Garā pastaiga", kur viņiem jāsaglabā noteikts gājiena ātrums, pretējā gadījumā viņi tiek nošauti. Galvenā balva ir liela naudas summa un visu vēlmju piepildījums līdz mūža beigām.

programme.title: Viņa brauc ar bisi
programme.desc: Nāvei nolemta jauna meitene metas bēgt un mācās izdzīvot no pēdējā cilvēka, kam uzticas – sava tēva, bijušā ieslodzītā.

programme.title: Steidzies rītdien
programme.desc: Bezmiega nomocīts mūziķis sastop noslēpumainu svešinieku, aizsākot ceļojumu, kas izaicina visu, ko viņš zina par sevi.

programme.title: UFC. Jean Silva-Jose Miguel Delgado
programme.desc: Martial Arts based TV programme. UFC stands for the Ultimate Fighting Championship which is an American mixed martial arts (MMA) promotion company based in Las Vegas that is owned by William Morris Endeavour.The purpose of UFC fighting was to establish the most effective martial art in a contest that had no weight classes and minimal rules that were as follows: no biting, hair pulling, groin shots and eye gouging. Legendary fighters well known for their ability to win in UFC fighting are Anderson Silva, Brock Lesnar, Connor McGregor and Ken Shamrock. Women's MMA has seen Ronda Rousey defend her title from 2012 to 2015 before she was defeated by Holly Holm another belt holder in more than one martial art.

programme.title: Futbols: Bundesliga. Hoffenheim - Stuttgart
programme.desc: Germany has the most attended football league in the world, in the Bundesliga. We bring these authentic fab experiences to your living room with all the key moments of the 2019-20 season, to ensure that your appetite for German football is well and truly met. The likes of Borussia Dortmund and Bayern Munich are met with stern competition this season, as RB Leipzig look to build on their third-placed finish from last season. This programme brings all the games of the german top-flight into one place, so that you can easily catch up with the week's action. As we reach the business end-of-the-season, watch the victors and losers dictate the final table. With relegation spots and Champions League places yet to be decided, it promises to be a rather exciting conclusion for all those concerned.

programme.title: Football: Serie A Full Impact

programme.title: Vacation House for Free
programme.desc: Matt Blashaw is determined to find the Gordon family the perfect vacation home in Lake Tahoe. They are hoping to buy a rustic, three bedroom-two bath home with convenient access to both the Lake and the mountains. With a central location being high on their list, Matt works to find an affordable fixer-upper that will get top dollar in the rental market after an extensive face lift. programme.title: Bargain Block
programme.desc: Bargain Block follows home renovation experts and partners Keith Bynum and Evan Thomas on their journey to restore Detroit's iconic American neighborhoods one house at a time. With sound advice and support from their friend—lifetime Detroit resident and real estate expert Shea Hicks-Whitfield, who is expecting her first child—Keith and Evan buy multiple rundown and abandoned houses on a single block, take them down to the studs, and create affordable, stylish and fully furnished starter homes that are ideal for first-time homebuyers. Now settled in the Motor City, the couple, who have renovated and purchased their own home and opened a new retail store and workshop, infuse every property with a functional layout, artful design and beautiful repurposed furniture. The end result is incredible transformations of dilapidated homes that are an inspiration to the entire neighborhood.

programme.title: The UnXplained with William Shatner
programme.desc: From the producers of Ancient Aliens® and The Curse of Oak Island® From alleged UFO encounters to sudden disappearances to evil possessions, series host William Shatner attempts to get to the truth behind the most bizarre and mysterious events ever reported. With the help of the world's top scientists, first-hand "experiencer" accounts, and dramatic reenactments, viewers gain shocking insight into what's really happening--and why.

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: Long before banks, ATMs and check-cashing services, there were pawn shops. Pawning was the leading form of consumer credit in the United States until the 1950s, and pawn shops are still helping everyday people make ends meet. "Pawn Stars" takes you inside the colorful world of the pawn business. At the Gold & Silver Pawn Shop on the outskirts of Las Vegas, three generations of the Harrison family — grandfather Richard, son Rick and grandson Corey — jointly run the family business, and there's clashing and camaraderie every step of the way. The three men use their sharp eyes and skills to assess the value of items from the commonplace to the truly historic, including a 16th-century samurai sword, a Super Bowl ring, a Picasso painting and a 17th-century stay of execution. It's up to them to determine what's real and what's fake, as they reveal the often surprising answer to the questions on everyone's mind, "What's the story behind it?" and "What's it worth?"

programme.title: The Curse of Oak Island
programme.desc: For over two centuries, teams of searchers, including Franklin D. Roosevelt, have attempted to crack the code that will unearth the treasure believed to be buried on the small island off the coast of Nova Scotia. Armed with the knowledge of those that came before them, the muscle of heavy machinery and decades of engineering know-how, brothers Rick and Marty Lagina and their partners may be closer than anyone in history to finding the treasure that has so far claimed the lives of six men.

Pawning was the leading form of consumer credit in the United States until the 1950s, and pawn shops are still helping everyday people make ends meet. "Pawn Stars" takes you inside the colorful world of the pawn business. At the Gold & Silver Pawn Shop on the outskirts of Las Vegas, three generations of the Harrison family — grandfather Richard, son Rick and grandson Corey — jointly run the family business, and there's clashing and camaraderie every step of the way. The three men use their sharp eyes and skills to assess the value of items from the commonplace to the truly historic, including a 16th-century samurai sword, a Super Bowl ring, a Picasso painting and a 17th-century stay of execution. It's up to them to determine what's real and what's fake, as they reveal the often surprising answer to the questions on everyone's mind, "What's the story behind it?" and "What's it worth?"

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Explores the controversial theory that extraterrestrials have visited Earth for millions of years. From the age of the dinosaurs to ancient Egypt, from early cave drawings to continued mass sightings in the US, each episode gives historic depth to the questions, speculations, provocative controversies, first-hand accounts and grounded theories surrounding this age old debate. Did intelligent beings from outer space visit Earth thousands of years ago?

programme.title: Ancient Aliens: Origins
programme.desc: Throughout history, legendary weaponry and advanced technologies have often been attributed to divine or extraterrestrial influences. Japanese swords were believed to be forged with the help of the supernatural, while mythical weapons granted by otherworldly beings were wielded by iconic figures like Joan of Arc and King Arthur. The enigmatic Greek fire is yet another weapon attributed to these so-called-gods.

programme.title: The Proof Is Out There
programme.desc: Did a Chilean family photograph a real UFO flying above the Andes Mountains? Is footage of a tall, dark-colored, hairy creature walking through the woods proof the legendary Ohio Grassman exists? Does a huge, 5,000-year-old horn discovered on a beach in England belong to a prehistoric creature that still lives? Scientists and citizens attempt to decipher the mysterious inscription of a sword found in River Witham, Lincolnshire. Tony Harris and his team of experts examine the clues...

programme.title: The Curse of Oak Island
programme.desc: For over two centuries, teams of searchers, including Franklin D. Roosevelt, have attempted to crack the code that will unearth the treasure believed to be buried on the small island off the coast of Nova Scotia. Armed with the knowledge of those that came before them, the muscle of heavy machinery and decades of engineering know-how, brothers Rick and Marty Lagina and their partners may be closer than anyone in history to finding the treasure that has so far claimed the lives of six men.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: A&E presents the new original real-life series "Storage Wars," which follows professional buyers and their teams as they scour repossessed storage units in search of hidden treasure. Part gamblers, part detectives, these auction pros have found everything from coffins to the world's most valuable comic book collection, paying as little as ten dollars for items valued in the millions. Each episode of "Storage Wars" follows a group of bidders as they get a quick peek inside the units, aided only by the beam of a flashlight. They then must assess on the spot if the unit is worth a bid and how high they will actually go to grasp the gold. The high-stakes fun begins as we see if the resulting buy is full of mostly trash... or true treasure. Driven by Dan Dotson, one of the most successful and outrageous auctioneers in the country, the cast of buyers is as colorful and varied as the treasures they uncover.

programme.title: Gold Hunters: Legend of the Superstition Mountains
programme.desc: Legend tells of the Lost Dutchman's gold mine hidden somewhere within the 160,000 acres of brutal Arizona desert known as the "Superstition Mountains." The promise of a $200 million mother lode has lured thousands of treasure hunters and continues to claim the lives of those eager to decipher the legend's clues and riddles. Hunting for the Lost Dutchman is typically a one-man journey, but lifelong Dutch Hunter Wayne Tuttle is breaking with tradition and partnering with a team of experts to follow a newly revealed clue that could finally solve the 500-year-old mystery of America's most famous and deadliest buried treasure. With cursed mountains said to drive men mad and a hidden fortune of gold worth killing for, the treasure hunter's greatest danger may be the man at his side. Trust at your own peril if you dare to tread into HISTORY's Legend of the Superstition Mountains.

programme.title: The UnXplained with William Shatner
programme.desc: From the producers of Ancient Aliens® and The Curse of Oak Island® From alleged UFO encounters to sudden disappearances to evil possessions, series host William Shatner attempts to get to the truth behind the most bizarre and mysterious events ever reported. With the help of the world's top scientists, first-hand "experiencer" accounts, and dramatic reenactments, viewers gain shocking insight into what's really happening--and why.

programme.title: Hunting Hitler
programme.desc: An FBI cold case that has laid dormant for 70 years leads a group of world-renown investigators on the ultimate manhunt to finally answer the question: Did Adolf Hitler survive World War II? In early 2014 the FBI declassified hundreds of confidential documents showing that Hitler may have not committed suicide but rather escaped to South America after the fall of Germany. A memo from J. Edgar Hoover himself states "American Army officials in Germany have not located Hitler's body nor is there any reliable source that will say definitely that Hitler is dead." Armed with the most cutting edge technology and these newly released FBI files the team will approach this case like a modern death claims investigation. Whether they are investigating a mysterious Nazi lair deep in the Argentinian jungle or diving for evidence of a missing U-Boat that could of shuttled Hitler to South America our team will focus on the tried and tested tenants for solving a fraudulent death case: follow the money where was the subject last seen, eyewitness reports, make contact with known associates and forensics.With declassified worldwide intelligence providing a wealth of new clues and modern technology never before available we reopen this world famous cold case in hopes of solving the mystery surrounding the demise of one of the biggest criminals of all time.

programme.title: The Universe
programme.desc: Every day, new information is discovered that helps us better understand how our Universe works. Some of this evidence solves mysteries dating back thousands of years. Some evidence offers new theories on how human civilization came into existence. In this season of The Universe: Ancient Mysteries Solved, we'll tackle mysteries such as an American Stonehenge built 500 years before Columbus, and how the Aztec Pyramids helped seal the downfall of the Mayan and Aztec empires. We'll also look at some of the Roman Empires' most iconic structures, and their connection to archeo-astronomy.

programme.title: Rome: Rise & Fall of an Empire
programme.desc: When Roman generals Pompey and Crassus lead their mighty legions of soldiers and mercenaries into the lands surrounding Italy, neither could anticipate the turmoil caused by one bold mercenary: Spartacus. A Thracian warrior, Spartacus deserts the Roman army, but is captured and made a slave, forced to fight as a gladiator. But in 73 BC the untamable barbarian leads a slave revolt of 70,000 gladiators against the Roman Republic. Though the brutal and conniving Roman General Crassus is finally able to suppress the revolt, his rival, the more popular Pompey, takes all the credit, sparking a division within the Republic itself that will ultimately spell its demise.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Throughout human history, the planet Mars has captured our imagination. Ancient Egyptian astronomers were the first to record the red planet on a chart of the cosmos known as the Senenmut star map. Scholars believe Mars played an important role in Maya astrology that's described in the Dresden Codex. And modern translation of Sumerian and Babylonian origin myths record a cataclysmic event occurring on Mars. Is our fascination with Mars simply because of its striking red color and prominence in the night sky? Or might we have a more profound extraterrestrial connection? For nearly 40 years, probes have been sending information about Mars back to scientists here on Earth. Photographs of the mysterious planet reveal mountain-like formations known as Twin Peaks and a strange, humanoid face carved into Martian rock. Has NASA found definitive signs of life on Mars that they're intentionally keeping from the public?

programme.title: MonsterQuest
programme.desc: From Bigfoot to Swamp Beast, Monster Quest reveals the truth of legendary monster sightings around the world. Deploying the latest in hi-tech equipment, each episode scientifically examines the best evidence available, from pictures and video, to hair and bones, as well as the eyewitness accounts themselves. From pilots to policemen to ship captains, a number of seemingly credible people have seen things they can't explain. One part history, one part science and one part monsters, Monster Quest discovers the truth behind these legendary monsters.

programme.title: River Hunters
programme.desc: In River Hunters, Rick Edwards and river-searching expert Beau Ouimette visit some of the most historically significant sites across Britain: covering iconic events and battles including Roman Briton, the Wars of the Roses, the Reformation and the English Civil War. Their searches of these unexplored rivers and waterways unearth treasures from the past which reveal how our various ancestors used to live. As the artefacts surface from under layers of silt and rocks, the duo will meet with local archaeologists and historians to unearth the stories and people behind the finds. programme.title: Rome: Rise & Fall of an Empire
programme.desc: It is 60 BC. Over-powerful generals and money corrupts the Roman Republic. The empire churns with civil war, and violence and murder run rampant in the streets. Julius Caesar, desperate for fame and honor, embarks on a brutal decade long campaign to annex Gaul and build his own reputation. His aristocratic rivals try to stop him, but he is an expert manipulator. His propaganda and extravagant victories against bloodthirsty barbarians thrill the public. In 49 BC, he crosses the Rubicon intending to claim his rightful place as the chief man of Rome. It sparks a new civil war that pits him against Pompey the Great and sounds the final death knell for the Republic.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Throughout history, spiritual leaders known as shamans have healed, protected and advised their people. But are they simply putting on elaborate ceremonies? Or could they be in contact with extraterrestrial realms? The Mongol army crushed their enemies and built a massive empire with the help of powerful shamans who could manipulate the weather. Amazonian shamans believe otherworldly beings taught them how to create a powerful brew that allows them to travel beyond Earth to gain knowledge. And on the desert plains of the Kalahari, the San Bushmen practice elaborate trance dances that unlock supernatural capabilities in their healers. Can shamans really communicate with otherworldly beings? Is it possible that through these spiritual mediators, extraterrestrials were able to influence mankind in the distant past? And could such celestial communication continue even today?

programme.title: Unidentified: Inside America's UFO Investigation
programme.desc: The team investigates an alarming pattern of UFOS allegedly appearing near US. Air Force bases that house nuclear weapons, and nuclear-powered US warships. A new eyewitness account suggests these craft have an incredible ability. Connections to a historic sighting where a UFO allegedly interfered with a U.S. nuclear weapon are explored. Elizondo briefs former U.S. Senator Harry Reid who offers a stunning theory about UFOS.

programme.title: UFO Hunters
programme.desc: In the early 1950's, James McDonald, a senior physicist at the University of Arizona, changed the entire course of UFO research. For nearly 20 years he examined UFO reports in great detail – interviewing over 500 witnesses, uncovering important government documents, and testifying before Congress in 1968. He challenged skeptics, performed scientific analysis, and led the charge for UFOs to be properly studied. After his tragic death in 1971, his investigations and files were sent to the University archives, where they lay dormant...until now. The team brings these lost UFO files back into the public eye for the first time on television, and looks at evidence long thought lost to history.

programme.title: UFO Files
programme.desc: In the search for life beyond our planet, this documentary investigates areas on earth that are said to have had UFO activity, conspiracy theories and phenomenons. Interviewing a variety of scientists and experts on UFOs and examining when possible evidence can prove or suggest anything towards super natural life. From going off of tales that have been told and spread through generations and or cultures to personal experiences where sighting have occurred the series covers the super natural phenomenon that is life beyond earth.
