programme.title: Ielas garumā
programme.desc: Pirms 16 gadiem "Ielas garumā" filmējām Neredzīgo ciematu Juglas ezera krastā, ko puslokā ietvēra Pāles iela, tālāk aizsniedzoties līdz pat Strazdupītei. Kopš 2016. gada Pāles ielas pusloks kļuvis par Braila ielu, bet kādas pārmaiņas notikušas apkārtējā vidē? Viens no jaunumiem - nesen atklātais Latvijas Neredzīgo biedrības Rehabilitācijas centrs. Vairāki nozīmīgi projekti vēsturiskajā Strazdumuižā top arī pēc Juglas apkaimes biedrības ierosmes, bet jaunais apkaimes centrs sāk veidoties gleznainā vietā pie Velnezera. Tā ir jauna adrese "Ielas garumā" Rīgas topogrāfijā.

programme.title: Ielas garumā
programme.desc: Iela, kurai vienā pusē atrodas Daugava ar trim tiltiem, bet otrā - Rīgas ikoniskā panorāma ar Vecrīgas torņiem, atrodas pašā Rīgas centrā, un tās vaibstos savus nospiedumus atstājuši daudzi gadsimti. Ielas nosaukums - 11. novembra krastmala - atgādina par rīdzinieku varonību bermontiādes laikā 1919. gadā, kad stipri cieta arī Rīgas pils. Diemžēl postījumi pilij tika nodarīti arī pirms 10 gadiem, kad tur izcēlās ugunsgrēks, skarot arī Latvijas Nacionālā vēstures muzeja telpas. Tagad muzejs gatavojas atgriezties atjaunotajās mājās. Zīmīgi, ka nesen jaunu veidolu un saturu jau ieguvis netālu esošais Okupācijas muzejs, bet muzeju saimei pievienojies Latvijas Mākslinieku savienības muzejs Mākslinieku namā. Labas pārmaiņas beidzot sāk piedzīvot arī apkārtējā vide, un tas varētu būt mazs solītis no automaģistrāles uz promenādi.

programme.title: Tutas Lietas
programme.desc: Cik rokai ir pirkstu? Kā pagatavot kūku no smiltīm? Un kā skan bungas? Izzinot sevi un pasauli, bērniem ir daudz jautājumu. "Tutas lietas" ir video stāstu sērija bērniem vecumā no viena līdz pieciem gadiem, ko žurnāliste un raidījumu vadītāja Marta Selecka radījusi kopā ar domubiedriem – mazu bērnu vecākiem no kino un TV profesionāļu vides. Raidījuma būtība – tas ir mīļš un izglītojošs ekrāna saturs pašiem mazākajiem, viņiem saprotamā valodā par interesantām un noderīgām tēmām. Raidījuma galvenā varone ir jaukā meitene, bērnu draudzene Tuta. Viņas lomā iejutusies aktrise un mamma Liene Sebre. Tuta mazajiem jautru rotaļu veidā māca pašus pirmos vārdus, krāsas, dziesmiņas un skaitļus. Kopā ar Tutu jaunas lietas bērniem apgūt palīdz arī draudzīgā un ziņkārīgā Lapsa. "Tutas lietu" stāstiņu kopējo konceptu veidojusi Marta Selecka, bet scenārijus sagatavojusi jaunā, talantīgā bērnu autore Inga Mastiņa. Bērniem saistošu radošu vizuālo noskaņu radījusi pieredzējusī dizainere Ilze Žūriņa-Šeibaka, bet Tutas dziesmas mūzikas autore un izpildītāja ir dziedātāja un komponiste Laura Polence. Tutas piedzīvojumus iemūžinājis operators Dāvis Doršs, bet projekta režiju un montāžu veidojusi Andra Doršs, kura par savu darbu Latvijas kino projektos ieguvusi arī Nacionālo kino balvu "Lielais Kristaps".

programme.title: 42 - Atbildes uz gandrīz visiem jautājumiem
programme.desc: Dokumentālo filmu cikls viegli saprotamā, taču zinātniski pamatotā veidā sniedz atbildes uz neparastiem jautājumiem. Un temati var būt visdažādākie, jautājumi – vispārsteidzošākie. Vai augiem ir emocijas, vai tie spēj just? Vai pasaules okeānu straumes drīz apstāsies? Kāpēc mēs patiesībā raudam? Zinātnieku sniegtās atbildes pārsteidz un liek paraudzīties uz pasauli no citas perspektīvas. Kāpēc nosaukumā ir skaitlis 42? Šeit dokumentālo filmu cikla veidotāji atsaucas uz rakstnieka Duglasa Adamsa zinātniskās fantastikas komēdijas grāmatu "Galaktikas ceļvedis stopētājiem", kurā superdators ir izskaitļojis, ka skaitlis 42 ir galīgā atbilde uz visiem Visuma jautājumiem.

programme.title: Gudrs, vēl gudrāks
programme.desc: Kompetenti eksperti katrā spēlē sagatavos atbilstošus jautājumus konkrētai vecuma grupai. Jautājumi ietvers mācību vielu un sabiedriski aktuālas tēmas mūzikā, mākslā, vēsturē, politikā un citās jomās. Savus jautājumus spēles dalībniekiem gan atraktīvā video formātā, gan tiešraidē studijā, sagatavo arī sabiedrībā zināmi cilvēki – kultūras jomas pārstāvji, zinātnieki, sportisti, politiķi, mūziķi un citi.

programme.title: Cilvēks.jpg
programme.desc: Šīs epizodes viesi - Māra Ulme un Kočāns Miķelis. Dzejniece Māra Ulme un mūziķis Kočāns Miķelis cīnīsies dzejas slamā ar rakstāmmašīnu, izdzīvos pirmatnējā uguns šķilšanas burvību un pārbaudīs sevi apģērba ilgtspējas testā. Redzēsim arī, kā Miķelis un Māra meklēs savus portretus daudzveidīgo krāsu plūsmā.

programme.title: Cilvēks.jpg
programme.desc: Māksliniece Ance un grupas "Vēstulēs" mūziķis Braiens izaicina viens otru ar Latvijas pilsētu rēbusu, pārbauda pacietību origami testā un atklāj savas politiskās ambīcijas! Protams, neiztikt bez mākslas un pārsteigumiem - šoreiz mūziķis pārsteigs mākslinieci, un otrādi!

programme.title: Aculiecinieks
programme.desc: 13 minūšu gari televīzijas stāsti vēsta par notikumiem un Latvijā īpašiem cilvēkiem, aptverot vēsturiskus, zinātnes, izglītības, pilsētas, lauku un daudzus citus tematus.

programme.title: Kultūrdeva
programme.desc: Raidījumā "Kultūrdeva" viesosies māksliniece Krista Vindberga-Auzniece, kurai "Kim?" laikmetīgās mākslas centrā atklāta izstāde "Circles Are Better Than Lines (oda pieskārienam)", un grupa "Carnival Youth", kuras albums "Labākā doma pasaulē" nominēts prestižajai "Austras" balvai.

programme.title: Vera
programme.desc: Izmeklētāja Vera ir parasta sieviete neparastā amatā. Mācījusies no skarbākajām dzīves dienām, viņa saglabā optimistisku skatu uz pasauli. Viņai ir laba humora izjūta un viņa ir ļoti piezemēta – izmeklētājai nepiemīt ne kripatas uzpūtības, lai gan viņa var būt skarba pret padotajiem. Dziļi sirdī viņa slēpj gadiem ilgušu vientulību, taču ārēji to slēpj aiz skarbas ironijas maskas. Veras lomu atveido aktrise Brenda Bletina, kas ir vairākkārt nominēta Oskaram, tā skaitā par lomu Maika Lī filmā "Noslēpumi un meli", par kuru arī ieguvusi "Zelta Globusu".

programme.title: Eiropas čempionāts volejbolā. Latvija – Francija
programme.desc: Francija noteikti jāpieskaita pie mūsu grupas favorītēm, un arī kopumā šai izlasei ir pa spēkam pretendēt uz medaļām Eiropas čempionātā. Viegli nebūs, taču ir jācīnās - no grupas četras labākās komandas no sešām tiks izslēgšana spēlēs. Volejbolā iespējams iegūt punktu arī par diviem uzvarētiem setiem, taču reāli pret Franciju gan to būs grūti izdarīt. Šonedēļ Latvijai trīs spēles, un jaunnedēļ vēl divas - jau pret relatīvi nedaudz vājākām izlasēm Turciju un Šveici. Viss gan ir relatīvi, jo pilnīgi visas izlases mūsu grupā reitingā ir augstāk par Latviju. Mums toties ir jauns galvenais treneris Uģis Krastiņš, kas agrāk pats bijis izcils spēlētājs un vēlāk ilgi vadījis spēcīgo Ukrainas valstsvienību. Skaidrs, ka komandas spēlē tiks ieviesti jauninājumi, treneris īpaši uzsver arī servju nozīmību, līdz šim Latvijai tas nebija spēcīgs ierocis, bet mūsdienu volejbolā bez tā neiztikt.

programme.title: Basketbols. Pasaules kauss sievietēm
programme.desc: Fināls basketbolā sievietēm ierakstā uzreiz pēc volejbola vīriešiem ar Latvijas līdzdalību, taču tiešraidē basketbolu finālu var skatīt replay.lv no pulksten 20.50. Pēdējos četros turnīros pasaules kausu basketbolā sievietēm ieguvusi ASV, kas arī šogad ir galvenā favorīte, kā nekā šajā zemē notiek ari sieviešu nacionālā basketbola līgas spēles WNBA. Tikai 2006. gadā pasaules kausu ieguva Austrālija, bet amerikānietes toreiz palika tikai trešās. Vispār no pārējo valstu komandām vēsturē pie zelta medaļām tikušas vienīgi austrālietes un arī Brazīlija (neskaitot Krieviju, kas nevar piedalīties valsts agresijas dēļ). Pēdējos finālturnīros katru reizi finālā ASV bijušas citas pretinieces - pirms četriem gadiem tās bija ķīnietes, vēl pirms tam Austrālija, Spānija un Čehija.

programme.title: Nakts reiss
programme.desc: Londonas detektīve Hana Lī ir norīkota pavadīt doktoru Metjū Nolanu uz Pekinu, kur viņš tiek apsūdzēts smagā noziegumā. Taču 357. nakts reisā uz Ķīnu Hana saprot, ka šis uzdevums nebūt nebūs tik vienkāršs – lidojuma laikā viņa tiek ierauta sarežģītā sazvērestībā, kurā neko nevar uztvert par pašsaprotamu. Nolans apgalvo, ka ir nevainīgs, bet Hana apšauba visu, ko līdz šim zinājusi, un to, kas ir viņas patiesie sabiedrotie. Nezināmi ienaidnieki vēlas panākt, lai Nolans nekad nesasniegtu galamērķi, bet Hana kļūst par mērķi tiem, kuri vēlas noslēpt patiesību par Nolana pagātni. Spriedzei pieaugot, lidmašīnā parādās pirmās slepkavības, un Hana saprot, ka atklājumi, kas viņu sagaida, var maksāt gan viņas, gan Nolana dzīvību.

programme.title: Policijas iecirknis
programme.desc: Klāras tēvs miris no saindēšanās ar oglekļa monoksīdu. Sākotnēji tā izskatās pēc pašnāvības, bet vai tiešām tā ir? Komanda izpēta pavedienu - anonīmo telefona numuru, no kura zvanīts iecirknim un sūtīta īsziņa Klārai. Tikmēr Stefans, Bruno un Patriks kārto Nika Romano lietu.

programme.title: Policijas iecirknis
programme.desc: Seriāls "Policijas iecirknis 31" seko stāstam par detektīvseržanti Nadīnu Legrānu un viņas kolēģi Patriku Bisonē, kā arī citiem viņu biedriem policijas iecirknī, kur viņi sastopas ar ikdienas noziegumiem, kas notiek lielajās pilsētās: slepkavības, nolaupīšanas, ielaušanās, vardarbība ģimenē, narkotiku tirdzniecība, terorisms un daudz kas cits.

programme.title: Ielas garumā
programme.desc: Tuvojoties Jelgavas centram no Rīgas puses, Lielupes krastā visā krāšņumā atklājas pilsētas vizītkarte - Jelgavas pils, kurā tagad iemājo Latvijas Biozinātņu un tehnoloģiju universitāte. Pils laikmetu griežos piedzīvotais un Kurzemes hercogu kapeņu vēsture varētu aizpildīt visu gājumu ielas garumā, bet tikpat aizraujoši ir Lielupes un Driksas dzīlēs pasmeltie stāsti un Lielupes palienes pļavās saklausītais, jo tur savvaļas zirgi mēdz runāt. Un vēl Garās salas, tagad Pilssalas līcīšos, iespējams, kādreiz atradusies senā zemgaļu osta, ko visu mūžu meklē arheologs un vēsturnieks Andris Tomašūns.

programme.title: Aizliegtais paņēmiens
programme.desc: Lai uzzinātu par kāda notikuma patiesajiem apstākļiem vai iesaistīto personu nodomiem, raidījuma "Aizliegtais paņēmiens" komanda informācijas iegūšanai izmanto visdažādākos izmeklējošās žurnālistikas paņēmienus un žanrus – eksperimentus, testus, provokācijas, padziļinātus pētījumus, arī anonīmas intervijas. Žurnālisti padziļināti pēta un skatītājiem atklāj sociālpolitiskus tematus, kas ne vienmēr tiek izcelti citos medijos. Raidījums atklāj un atmasko, atsevišķos gadījumos sauc pie atbildības iesaistītās personas, norāda uz likumu nepilnībām, aicina mainīt pastāvošo kārtību, ja tā ir pretrunā sabiedrības interesēm. Raidījumu vada LTV Ziņu dienesta žurnālists Guntis Bojārs.

programme.title: Sporta studija
programme.desc: "Mūsu uzņemtais virziens izsakāms neformālā sauklī "sports sabiedrībai!". Šis virziens tika uzsākts jau iepriekš ar "Tautas sporta" sižetu sērijām un sporta laukumu kampaņām. Turpmāk LTV Tautas sporta sižeti būs tradicionāla "Sporta studijas" sastāvdaļa. "Sporta Studiju" vadīs rūdītie sporta žurnālisti Dāvids Ernštreits un Reinis Ošenieks, kā arī jaunās sporta žurnālistikas zvaigznes Andris Auziņš, Matīss Timofejevs un Raimonds Gekišs. "Sporta studijas" aktualitātēm sekojiet https://www.facebook.com/LTVSportaStudija

programme.title: Province
programme.desc: "Province" – tie ir valsts bēniņi. Tā ir kā savdabīga pasaule, kam ikdienā mēs, viesistabu un guļamistabu apdzīvotāji, nepievēršam daudz uzmanības. Laiks šeit rit pēc citiem likumiem. Tas atnāk gandrīz tikpat ātri, bet aiziet lēnāk un ilgāk kavējas. Katrai valstij un tautai ir vajadzīgi savi bēniņi. Tie dod kādu īpašu stabilitāti, kas nekā citādi nav iegūstama. Bēniņu lielākā bagātība ir to spēja būt citādiem…

programme.title: Vienmēr formā!
programme.desc: Deutsche Welle žurnāls.

programme.title: Rīta Panorāma
programme.desc: Enerģisks un iedvesmojošs sākums jaunai dienai! Ieskats gaidāmās dienas notikumos Latvijā un pasaulē, kultūras, izklaides un sporta ziņas, laika prognoze. Arī atskats uz aizvadītās dienas notikumiem, pievēršot uzmanību to attīstībai nakts laikā. Aizrautīgas sarunas ar viesiem un skanīgi muzikālie priekšnesumi. Raidījumu vada Gusts Kikusts, Sigurds Siliņš, Karīna Rubene, Danuta Juste, sporta ziņas lasa Reinis Ošenieks, Raimonds Gekišs, laika ziņas – Ilze Skudra, Ilze Golubeva, Toms Bricis.

programme.title: Pasaules panorāma
programme.desc: Globālo ziņu laikmetā notikums Āzijā vai Amerikas kontinentā jau rīt var mainīt dzīvi Eiropā, bet lēmums, kas pieņemts Rīgā – atbalsoties visā pasaulē. "Pasaules panorāma" piedāvā neatkarīgas un uzticamas ziņas, atspoguļojot un analizējot ārpolitikas aktualitātes, kā arī sarunas ar politologiem, ārpolitikas ekspertiem, pasaulē pazīstamām personībām par svarīgāko Baltijā un Ziemeļvalstīs, citviet Eiropā, kā arī visā pasaulē. Raidījumu vada LTV Ziņu dienesta ārzemju ziņu redaktori Toms Pastors un Ina Strazdiņa.

programme.title: Pasaules maratonists
programme.desc: Pasaules maratonists tiekas ar apbrīnas vērtiem cilvēkiem un uzklausa dažādus brīnumainus dzīvesstāstus. Kāds nedēļas laikā noskrējis 525 kilometrus. Kāds iesaistījies kustībā, kas palīdz maratonos piedalīties cilvēkiem ar invaliditāti. Kāds turpina skriet vēl 90 gadu vecumā. Un vēl Rauls vēsta par to, kā radusies maratona skriešana, kas vieno visus grieķus. Bet pats skrien visautentiskāko no visiem maratoniem.

programme.title: Kas notiek Latvijā?
programme.desc: Diskusijas un intervijas par sabiedrībai nozīmīgām norisēm. Vada žurnālists Jānis Domburs.

programme.title: Mērdoka noslēpumi
programme.desc: Operas "Bohēma" mēģinājuma laikā tiek noindēta viena no dziedātājām, Elvīra Kamingsa. Mērdokam rodas aizdomas, ka, iespējams, inde bija paredzēta citai dziedātājai – trupas prīmai Rozai Hemiltonei. Tā kā Brekenrīds ir kaislīgs viņas talanta pielūdzējs, viņš piesakās viņu apsargāt. Viņa sievai Mārgaritai tas nemaz nepatīk.

programme.title: Mērdoka noslēpumi
programme.desc: Tiek nogalināts izgudrotājs Aivens Valenskis, kurš nodarbojās ar akumulatoru izstrādi. Viņš kopā ar Džeimsu Pendriku strādāja pie elektroauto radīšanas. Pendriks ir pārliecināts, ka slepkava jāmeklē starp viņa konkurentiem, viens no kuriem ir arī Henrijs Fords. Brekenrīdam rodas aizdomas, ka Mārgarita varētu viņu krāpt. Viņš lūdz, lai Krebtrijs viņu izseko.

programme.title: Alpu dakteris
programme.desc: Nav labākas vietas, kur patverties no pilsētas kņadas, trokšņa un stresa, kā kalni. Bet dzīvot tur? Dzimto Alpu mazpilsētiņu, saucot tās gaisotni par smacējošu un aprobežotu, Mārtins pameta jau pirms daudziem gadiem, lai kļūtu par veiksmīgu ārstu kosmopolītiskajā lielpilsētā Ņujorkā. Nu viņš ir atgriezies. Uz pavisam īsu apciemojumu, lai atkal drīz atvadītos. Taču no likteņa neizbēgsi - atgriešanās mājās izrādās uz palikšanu. Jo pārāk liels ir trieciens, uzzinot, ka viņa pirmā mīlestība, kas pēc Mārtina aizbraukšanas apprecēja viņa paša brāli Hansu, ir mirusi. Taču atstājusi meitu, par kuras esamību Mārtins nekad pat nebija zinājis! Ar to izrādās pietiekami, lai izlemtu palikt Pēkšņi kļuvis par tēvu, Mārtins vēlas uzzināt vairāk par savu jauniegūto meitu Lili, iemantot viņas uzticēšanos. Tā dēļ viņš ir gatavs pat mēģināt sadarboties ar savu jaunāko brāli Hansu, kas joprojām jūt aizvainojumu. Hanss ir kļuvis par glābēju komandas vadītāju, un kopā ar Mārtinu viņi turpmāk neskaitāmas reizes riskēs ar savu dzīvību, lai glābtu kalnu negadījumu upurus vai kāpējus, ko pārsteigusi pēkšņa vētra. Mārtinu gaida atklāsme, ka bez saknēm nav iespējas turpināt dzīvi. Šeit viņš pilnībā aptvers arī to, ka būt par ārstu kalnos - tā nav tikai profesija, bet gan aicinājums. Kļūt par labu neatliekamās medicīniskās palīdzības sniedzēju kalnos iemācīties nevar, par tādu piedzimst. Un Mārtins Grūbers tāds neapšaubāmi ir!

programme.title: Vieglatlētika. Dimanta līga Briselē
programme.desc: Otrajā un pēdējā sacensību dienā Briselē kārtējo reizi būs ļoti daudz dažādu disciplīnu, tostarp arī šķēpa mešana sievietēm. Anetei Sietiņai gan neizdevās starts nesen notikušajā Eiropas čempionātā, taču Dimanta līgā vairākos posmos viņa startējusi samērā sekmīgi, kaut pārliecinoša līdere ir Ķīnas sportiste Jaņa Dziji, otra veiksmīgākā ir serbiete Adriana Vilagoša. Sietiņai tomēr vajadzētu kvalificēties finālam Briselē, vēl augusta vidū viņa bija piektā labākā kopvērtējumā, un tas garantē līdzdalību finālā. Sestdien būs ļoti daudz aizraujošu notikumu, tostarp fināls trīssolī vīriešiem, augstlēkšanā sievietēm, tāpat tāllēkšanā, arī 100 metru sprintā sievietēm un 200 metros vīriešiem. Tie nav vienīgie notikumi, kopā ir 16 dažādi veidi un visi fināli, turklāt šis ir visas sezonas fināls. Dimanta līgas sacensības notiek jau kopš 2010. gada, kad tās aizstāja toreizējo Zelta līgu. Pēdējās trijās sezonās Dimanta līgā bijuši 15 dažādi posmi, iepriekš mazāk. Katrā posmā katrā disciplīnā par ieņemtajām vietām sportisti krāj punktus, un tad veiksmīgākie var startēt pēdējā fināla posmā Briselē. Interesanti, ka vēsturē visvairāk Dimanta līgas titulu ieguvuši divi sportisti – amerikāņu trīssoļlēcējs Kristians Teilors un franču kārtslēcējs Reno Lavilenī, kas katrs triumfējuši septiņas reizes. No aktīvajiem sportistiem seši tituli ir arī amerikāņu sprinterim Noam Lailsam, slavenajam zviedru kārtslēcējam Armandam Duplantisam ir pieci, tāpat kā titulētajai Nīderlandes 400 metru barjerskrējējai Femkei Brūdersai-Bolai, kas šosezon gan skrien 800 metrus.

programme.desc: Latvijas Sirdsdziesma ir sirsnīgi muzikāls raidījums, kurā tiek atspoguļotas tautā vispopulārākās latviešu mūzikas dzīves norises šī vārda visplašākajā nozīmē.

programme.title: Zīdītāji
programme.desc: Svelme var būt mokoša, bet zīdītāji ir raduši risinājumus arī tās pārvarēšanai. Bārdainie kapucīni atraduši ūdeni vietā, kur to grūti dabūt, – ar pērtiķa izveicību vien nepietiek, jāliek lietā arī prāts. Austrālijas svelmainajos tuksneša plašumos vienkupra kamielis dodas partneres meklējumos – atbilde, kā viņš var izdzīvot bez ūdens pat vairākus mēnešus, slēpjas viņa raksturīgākajā iezīmē, bet dāmas viņš spēj savaldzināt veidā, kādā to dara tikai kamieļi. Madagaskaras lemuri atraduši ļoti neparastu un mīlīgu veidu, kā atpūsties no spiedīgā karstuma, turpretim ehidnām ir neparasta metode, kā izvairīties no kāda cita svelmes avota. Nemaz nerunājot par vampīrsikspārņu unikālo diētu… Lieli un mazi zīdītāji – visiem ir kāds risinājums, kā pieveikt svelmi un mierīgi dzīvot karstākajos zemeslodes reģionos.

programme.title: Nāve paradīzē
programme.desc: Uzņēmuma priekšsēdētāja tiek atrasta nošauta savā gultā pēc tam, kad sapulcinājusi savus darbiniekus uz kolektīva saliedēšanas pasākumu. Hamfrijam šķiet, ka vainīgs varētu būt kāds no viņas padotajiem, līdz uzzina, ka šautā brūce veikta pēc nāves - sieviete nožņaugta trīs stundas pirms šāviena. Uz vienīgajiem atrastajiem pierādījumiem nav neviena pirkstu nospieduma….

programme.title: Dzīve savvaļā kopā ar Benu Fouglu
programme.desc: Bens Fougls dodas pie cilvēkiem, kuri ierasto dzīvi nomainījuši pret nomaļām saimniecībām, tuksnesi un kalniem. Viņš iepazīst viņu ikdienu, iesaistās saimniecības darbos un noskaidro, kas pamudinājis izvēlēties tik neparastu ceļu. Portugāles austrumu kalnos Bens Fougls apmetas pie Aleksa Salija, kurš saspringtu darbu mazumtirdzniecībā nomainījis pret pussabrukušu saimniecību. Alekss pats atjauno ēkas un mācās apsaimniekot 14 hektārus zemes. Bens iesaistās darbos un iepazīst Aleksa nākotnes ieceres.

programme.title: Policijas iecirknis
programme.desc: Veronika satraucas, ka Ramano zina faktus par viņu, ko var izmantot tiesā, taču viņa taupīs savu trumpi īstajam brīdim. Kāds Davids Morels izsauc policiju un paziņo, ka drukā viltotu naudu un viņam tas apnicis, turklāt apgalvo, ka neko vairāk nedrīkst atklāt, jo tad cilvēki mirs. Šķiet, ka lieta atkal saistīta ar "Sixers".

programme.title: Vera
programme.desc: Izmeklētāja Vera ir parasta sieviete neparastā amatā. Mācījusies no skarbākajām dzīves dienām, viņa saglabā optimistisku skatu uz pasauli. Viņai ir laba humora izjūta un viņa ir ļoti piezemēta – izmeklētājai nepiemīt ne kripatas uzpūtības, lai gan viņa var būt skarba pret padotajiem. Dziļi sirdī viņa slēpj gadiem ilgušu vientulību, taču ārēji to slēpj aiz skarbas ironijas maskas. Veras lomu atveido aktrise Brenda Bletina, kas ir vairākkārt nominēta Oskaram, tā skaitā par lomu Maika Lī filmā "Noslēpumi un meli", par kuru arī ieguvusi "Zelta Globusu".

programme.title: Midsomeras slepkavības
programme.desc: Detektīvs Toms Bārnabijs ir pacietīgs un metodisks izmeklētājs. Viņš saprot, ka noziegumiem mazā pilsētiņā vienmēr būs sociāls raksturs, tamdēļ svarīgi izprast tās iedzīvotāju attiecības. Tikai un vienīgi viņš spēj pamanīt neskaidrus mājienus un sadzīt pēdas viltīgam slepkavam brīdī, kad nupat, šķiet, tas izbēgs nesodīts. Kad Toms Bārnabijs atgriežas mājās, viņš ir mīlošs vīrs un tēvs, tomēr, neskatoties uz to, detektīvs viņā nekad nesnauž. Citreiz vistrāpīgākās atklāsmes rodas tieši pie brokastu galda! Seriāls "Midsomeras slepkavības" ieturēts vislabākajās britu klasiskā detektīva tradīcijās: virkne aizdomās turamo, sajauktas pēdas, mīklaini mājieni, neizprotami motīvi un iespēja skatītājam pašam minēt, kurš šoreiz būs vainīgais. Seriāls veiksmīgi izrādīts teju visās Eiropas valstīs, kā arī ASV, Kanādā, Dienvidāfrikā un Tuvajos Austrumos, kopumā tas tiek uzņemts jau vairāk nekā 25 gadus.

programme.title: 42 - Atbildes uz gandrīz visiem jautājumiem
programme.desc: Dokumentālo filmu cikls viegli saprotamā, taču zinātniski pamatotā veidā sniedz atbildes uz neparastiem jautājumiem. Un temati var būt visdažādākie, jautājumi – vispārsteidzošākie. Vai augiem ir emocijas, vai tie spēj just? Vai pasaules okeānu straumes drīz apstāsies? Kāpēc mēs patiesībā raudam? Zinātnieku sniegtās atbildes pārsteidz un liek paraudzīties uz pasauli no citas perspektīvas. Kāpēc nosaukumā ir skaitlis 42? Šeit dokumentālo filmu cikla veidotāji atsaucas uz rakstnieka Duglasa Adamsa zinātniskās fantastikas komēdijas grāmatu "Galaktikas ceļvedis stopētājiem", kurā superdators ir izskaitļojis, ka skaitlis 42 ir galīgā atbilde uz visiem Visuma jautājumiem.

programme.title: Daudz laimes, jubilār!
programme.desc: Līdz ar septembri pie skatītājiem atkal nāk Latvijas Televīzijas lielo interviju raidījums "Daudz laimes, jubilār!", un kā pirmais raidījumā tiek sumināts vasaras jubilārs, Dailes teātra aktieris Gints Grāvelis. Gints teātrī ienāca kā Dailes teātra 8. studijas absolvents un, kaut sākotnēji nemaz netika iekļauts teātra štata sarakstā, savu līdzšinējo aktiera likteni var dēvēt par laimīgu. Par savu teātra krusttēvu Gints sauc Hariju Spanovski, savā ziņā arī turpinādams Spanovska ampluā, gan savā vizuālajā tēlā, gan balss tembrā uz skatuves uznesdams krietnu devu vīrišķā pirmsākuma neatvairāmā šarma un jaudas. Par sevi Grāvelis iesmējis, ka ir vienkāršs vecis, – kāds, cēlies no gruntīgas Skrundas četru brāļu ģimenes, arī patiešām ir! Gints ir īsts kurzemnieks, kas nebaidās darba un allaž ir gatavs jauniem izaicinājumiem. "Laižam!" – viņš tikai optimistiski nosmej. Pēdējos gados viens no lielākajiem eksāmeniem, ko viņš teicami nokārtojis, ir Blaumaņa Edgara loma Regnāra Vaivara un Kārļa Lāča mūziklā Liepājas teātrī. Liepājas teātra kolēģi par Ginta talantu izteikušies ļoti cildinoši: "Viņš sevi atdod mirklim pilnībā. Un šim mirklim arī dzīvo." (Zanda Borga) Nav šaubu, ka krāšņus stāstus, smieklus un gluži vai spāniski emocionālu žestikulāciju var gaidīt arī "Daudz laimes, jubilār!" skatītāji.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue: Highway Havoc!
programme.desc: Journey through the unforgiving and inhospitable climate of Norway's frozen mountains with the elite rescue crews who come to the aid of stranded travellers and battle round-the-clock to maintain access to vital road links. With sudden changes in the weather, from torrential rain to snow blizzards and sudden temperature changes, the teams have their work cut out for them. Risking life and limb in some of Europe's harshest conditions, it takes a special breed of men and women to overcome the many challenges thay face on a daily basis. As the roads turn into icy bobsleigh tracks, haulage container vehicles and private cars and vans all get themselves into difficulties and need to be rescued by our road warrior heroes.

programme.title: Airport Security: Colombia
programme.desc: Antinarcotics police officers at El Dorado International Airport must complete their mission to disrupt the activity of drug traffickers. First, they will detect an ingeniously hidden cocaine shipment with the help of specially trained dogs. Later, thanks to their X-ray equipment, they thwart the attempt of a man to smuggle cocaine capsules inside his stomach while they also rush to save his life. Immigrations officers live moments of dramatic tension when a mother tries to take her daughter out of the country with forged documents. Later, they must stop a passenger from evading justice by leaving the country. Meanwhile, the officers working at the post office will intercept a shipment of cocaine hidden inside an apparently innocent children's movie, and they will discover that a cargo of thirty handcrafted ceramic statuettes of Latin American political leaders might not be what it appears to be. In one of the security check-points, the infrared control system for luggage manages to catch an unexpected stash of ten kilograms of liquid cocaine, stored inside deodorant canisters. Later, the officers must sharpen their senses when the shoes of two passengers, pretending to be buddies on a holiday trip, might yield evidence that could land the two men in jail.

programme.title: Airport Security: To Catch a Smuggler Latin America Compilation
programme.desc: Parents with kids are arrested for drug-trafficking. From Airport Security Colombia and Peru, cocaine busts that include families. A mother with kids going to Barcelona carries cocaine in food packages. A man with kids at home confesses. A mother leaving the country with kids uses fake documents. A woman with her infant son enters the country with help from officials. A couple are not what they seem. The woman did it to help her daughter.

programme.title: Airport Security: To Catch a Smuggler Latin America Compilation
programme.desc: Carriers are often defiant towards officials, but crumble in the end. Cases of protest and denial from Airport Security Colombia and Peru. Sisters deny ingesting drugs but break down when one reveals she is pregnant. A drunk man denies the checked bag is his but is arrested and confesses. A young woman claims she is innocent but may have a mental illness. A young man with liquid cocaine in beer lies at first, but then breaks down.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler: Tropical Takedown
programme.desc: Smugglers use bleach and false-bottom floors to conceal 350 kilos of cocaine, but Mayagüez Air and Marine agents uncover the stash. In the U.S. Virgin Islands, agents race around St. Thomas to intercept suspected traffickers caught on hidden trail cameras. On the west side of Puerto Rico, agents discover firearms aboard two vessels suspected of smuggling narcotics from the Dominican Republic.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler: Tropical Takedown
programme.desc: An early morning pursuit with the Fajardo Air and Marine unit ends in the arrest of drug traffickers with over 900 kilos of cocaine aboard their boat. Suspected smugglers are detained in a lights out vessel in the U.S Virgin Islands with a gun onboard. Air and Marine Operations and law enforcement agencies across the Caribbean pay tribute to a fallen Air and Marine agent.

programme.title: Running Wild with Bear Grylls
programme.desc: Survivalist Bear Grylls returns to the wild with some of Hollywood's most beloved celebrities for a new season of his outdoor adventure series. From Marvel superheroes to award winning entertainers, a new guest joins Bear each week for a no-holds-barred journey through some of the most extreme environments in the world. Together, they must rely on bush craft techniques to survive each dangerous location while pushing through both mental and physical limits to brave even the most challenging obstacles.

programme.title: Running Wild with Bear Grylls
programme.desc: Actress, supermodel, and social media influencer Cara Delevingne realizes a long-held dream of accompanying Bear Grylls on an adventure. Sweeping Cara off her scooter and onto a helicopter, the two ascend into the mountains of Sardinia. At nearly a mile high in elevation, Bear shows Cara how to brave several heart-stopping obstacles including pulling herself across a horizontal line suspended 200 feet in the air and a dangerous waterfall rappel.

programme.title: Running Wild with Bear Grylls
programme.desc: Comedic actor Rob Riggle joins Bear Grylls on an adventure on Iceland's Vatnajokull glacier. Their journey begins with a helicopter ride over "the land of fire and ice", aptly named for constant volcanic activity beneath the surface. Once dropped off, Bear and Rob must navigate a stretch of jagged ice fields, deep moulins, and deep crevasses. Without food or supplies to make shelter, their mission is to find an airdropped emergency cache- without it, there's no way they can survive the frigid night!

programme.title: Running Wild with Bear Grylls
programme.desc: Captain Marvel herself, Brie Larson accompanies Bear on a jungle adventure across a remote island in the Gulf of Panama. A 48-hour getaway from Hollywood is what this Oscar winner needs, but there's no such thing as a relaxing vacation with Bear Grylls! Their journey starts by jumping out of a helicopter into the ocean. From there, it's a perilous trek through a crocodile-filled mangrove swamp that turns into a dangerous maze as the tide rises. It'll take Bear's bush craft skills and Brie's super powers to complete this adventure!

programme.title: Running Wild with Bear Grylls
programme.desc: Bear Grylls takes former WWE world champion and action star Dave Bautista on a super-sized adventure in the Arizona desert. Navigating through perilous canyon descents, brutal falls and the raging Colorado River will be no easy task. With Bear as his tag team partner, Dave is up for the challenge to see if he still has that fight inside - but Mother Nature could prove to be his toughest opponent yet in this match of a lifetime!

programme.title: Running Wild with Bear Grylls
programme.desc: It's been five years since Channing Tatum first appeared on Running Wild, and he's back for more- this time in the wilds of Norway! Their journey kicks off by skydiving into brutal terrain where giant boulder fields and towering cliffs stand in the way of extraction. During their seven-mile trek, Bear tests Channing to see how far he's come as a survivor - from foraging for food to Navy SEAL style cold-water emersion training. Channing even learns the ancient art of trout tickling!

programme.title: Break It Down
programme.desc: The Volvo FH12 Globetrotter: After over a hundred thousand miles of hauling cargo, this Euro truck is headed for a breakdown. But in Sweden, a country known for it's "green" initiatives, Volvo's goal is for 90% percent of the truck to be reused, or recycled. Piece-by-piece, a team of experts must remove everything from the 350 horsepower engine, to the 8-foot tall cab, so it can be recycled, and reborn, even bigger.

programme.title: Made in a Day
programme.desc: There's been a revolution in manufacturing and international logistics in the last 10 years. What used to take a month to make and deliver now takes just a day and nowhere is this more evident than in the USA - an economic powerhouse at the heart of the global economy. In this brand-new series, we unveil the incredible scale and human ingenuity behind the manufacture and transportation of some of America's biggest, global brands.

programme.title: Inside Incredible Machines
programme.desc: A futuristic new mode of transportation, part plane, part boat, and part helicopter, the launch of the hovercraft in 1969 was unlike anything ever seen. After 31 years of service and a collective 2.5 million miles back and forth across the English Channel, they were decommissioned. As a salvage team prepares to take one apart to sell whatever they can for recycling, former NASA engineer Chad Zdenek examines the engineering genius involved in making the hovercraft a giant of its time.

programme.title: Inside Incredible Machines
programme.desc: For forty years, Nimitz class aircraft carriers have delivered US military might wherever it is needed, anywhere on the globe. But now, this legendary design is being phased out and new carriers are planned. But until they're ready, the giant Nimitz ships have to be kept at the forefront of military technology. In this episode, engineer and host Chad Zdenek spends a week on board the USS Carl Vinson to work with the highly trained specialist engineers, mechanics and sailors who keep this incredible floating city in perfect working order during a critical mission in the Pacific - training twenty F18 pilots who have never taken off from an Aircraft Carrier before. This gives Chad the chance to discover the five engineering innovations at the heart of America's most incredible Aircraft Carrier.

programme.title: Disaster Autopsy
programme.desc: Three real world disasters forensically analysed and dissected in astonishing detail using 3D graphics, expert analysis and all available evidence. Why did the 100,000 tonne container ship MV Dali lose control in Baltimore harbour and hit the Francis Scott Key Road Bridge? And why was the bridge so vulnerable to a collision? What went wrong on board LOT flight 007 over Warsaw, Poland, that made it fall out of the sky? Pilot error? Mechanical failure? How did it manage to miss a building full of young people as it plunged to the ground? What caused the leak of a lethal chemical from the pesticide plant at Bhopal in Northern India? Why was it so deadly? Why didn't safety systems protect the victims?

programme.title: Disaster Autopsy
programme.desc: Disasters can strike anywhere, anytime. To find out why, expert analysis of the available evidence is used to recreate real world disasters in cutting edge 3D graphics. We can dissect them, peel back the layers, even freeze time to reveal a disaster's hidden and surprising causes – a paperwork error, a bad glue job, changing a restaurant opening hours. Whatever it is, Disaster Autopsy will uncover it.

programme.title: Pompeii: Out of Time with Tom Hiddleston
programme.desc: As Vesuvius begins to stir, Tom Hiddleston asks a crucial question: Will anyone recognize the warning signs in time? Tracing two real Romans — a teenage apprentice and a formidable businesswoman — he uncovers a city carrying on as earthquakes intensify. With the clock already ticking, Tom investigates why people ignore danger and whether these first decisions sealed their fate.

programme.title: Pompeii: Out of Time with Tom Hiddleston
programme.desc: As Vesuvius erupts, Tom Hiddleston asks: In the face of chaos, who escapes, and who takes control? Following Avianius, racing to save his mother, and Julia Felix, sheltering her household, he also uncovers a mysterious Praetorian Guard in Herculaneum. Is he a bystander or a leader? As darkness falls and the first deadly phase hits, Tom investigates whether anyone can still get out alive.

programme.title: Pompeii: Out of Time with Tom Hiddleston
programme.desc: As the final, lethal surges strike, Tom Hiddleston confronts the final question: What does it mean to survive? Investigating Julia Felix's final decision, the Praetorian's sacrifice and the fate of Avianius, Tom uncovers new evidence that challenges everything we think we know about Pompeii. In the face of total destruction, he reveals not just who lived but what survival really meant.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: During a regional commuter hop in New Zealand, the pilots of Eagle Airways Flight 2300 struggle to lower their landing gear. They circle the airport to troubleshoot the issue. Low on fuel, they have no choice but to eventually attempt a wheels-up landing. With emergency crews standing by, their twin-engine turboprop gently touches down, slides along the centre of the runway, and comes to a stop—remarkably with no injuries and minimal damage to the aircraft. With a potential disaster narrowly averted, investigators look into what could have caused the landing gear to fail. They soon track a hydraulic leak to a minor part with a major flaw. When they later test the entire fleet of Beechcraft turboprops, they uncover a systemic issue that's endangering passengers worldwide.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: An out-of-control turboprop breaks apart while trying to land at Düsseldorf airport, instantly killing everyone on board. German investigators locate every piece of the wreckage within the huge crash site, then painstakingly reconstruct the entire plane in order to determine what went wrong on board Nuremberg Flight 108. Investigators soon uncover a piece of the wreckage with telltale signs of a lightning strike. And as they dig deeper, find conclusive evidence that the powerful jolt jumped from the fuselage to the electrical system, causing a total power failure that disabled critical instruments and plunged the cockpit into darkness. Faced with a one-in-a-million disaster scenario no one saw coming, the disoriented crew lost control of their aircraft. Investigators conclude there was nothing they could have done to save their plane.

programme.title: Mysterious Islands
programme.desc: Abandoned structures and machinery on an island near Antarctica point to brief human settlements. Disturbing noises heard by foreign diplomats in Cuba set off research on a possible global psychological phenomenon. Mysterious rubber-like slabs from Indonesia appear on European beaches. A strange stone pattern found in the waters of Florida's Dry Tortugas National Park reveals a long-lost island.

programme.title: Mysterious Islands
programme.desc: A headless skeleton is discovered on Australia's Beacon Island. Near the Marshall Islands in the Pacific Ocean, a huge undersea crater is explored. In Mexico, an investigation into an eerie island full of dolls reveals grim history. Strange animal bones are found in a grave on an island in the English Channel.

programme.title: 9/11: The Plane That Hit The Pentagon
programme.desc: ON SEPTEMBER 11, 2001, one hundred and eighty-four innocent people lost their lives at the Pentagon. It is a fact that is fading from our collective memory. Today, its not uncommon to find people who dont know that the Pentagon was even a target - let alone the huge number of casualties. Though they helped define a generation, the individual acts of bravery and heroism that took place at the Pentagon are still relatively unknown. Even less widely known is that within an hour of the first attack, officials on the ground at the Pentagon received word that another hijacked flight was headed their way. For some evacuation was not an option. On the 15th Anniversary of the attack, survivors and first responders many for the first time share their raw and vivid recollections of the day that forever changed the world.

programme.title: 9/11 Rescue Cops
programme.desc: New to More4: This riveting documentary shares the extraordinary story of the heroism and sacrifice of the New York Police Department's elite rescue squad, the Emergency Service Unit (ESU), on 9/11. The ESU is a unique institution made up of highly specialised officers who are trained in search and rescue, hazardous materials containment and dealing with the structural collapse of buildings. On 9/11 they were tasked with rescuing as many people as possible, by any means possible, and of all the "E-Men" who rushed into the World Trade Center on that fateful day, 14 lost their lives. This programme features archive material and moving first-hand testimony to tell the inspirational story of the 9/11 elite rescue cops.

programme.title: Voyagers: Exploring Pacific Waters
programme.desc: 4000 years ago, in hand-built canoes, people dare to venture into the unexplored Pacific Ocean, searching for islands to start new lives on. Over countless generations they voyage from Taiwan to Vanuatu and beyond. Guided by the sea, stars and the stories of their ancestors, they become master navigators, and unlock a sea of islands. But ocean exploration brings great risks. To overcome merciless natural barriers, these voyagers must deeply understand the brutally powerful Pacific. They build homes on thousands of islands, developing rich cultures filled with song, dance and legends of the sea. But after discovering Fiji, Samoa and Tonga, they find no more islands. Their ocean world remains connected by their canoes, and for 1000 years voyagers sail into unknown, perilous waters, hoping that one day the sea will lead them to new lands.

programme.title: Voyagers: Exploring Pacific Waters
programme.desc: Pacific voyagers set sail heading east. For the last 1000 years they have sailed between settled islands, stretching from Fiji to the Philippines, and unsuccessfully searched for new islands. Now, with bigger, stronger double hull canoes, amazing navigators find the paradise islands of Tahiti. However, for these adventurous voyagers, this is just the beginning. Fearlessly they cross wild, stormy seas and voyage into the unexplored Pacific. Following the winds and their ancestors' stories they find the tiny Easter Island. The birds lead them to Hawai'i and they follow whales and the stars of Maui's Hook to New Zealand. They find every island in the Pacific and strong cultures evolve. Empires are established and warriors fight brutal sea battles. But when European boats cross the horizon, this ocean world will change forever.

programme.title: Mysterious Islands
programme.desc: Ruins excavated on Pitcairn Island shed light on a previously unknown civilization. In the jungle of Borneo, researchers discover a strange green light in the pitch-dark forest. The remains of a long-lost temple are found decaying on the Greek island of Euboea. Coral rubble unearthed on Sudan's Suakin Island unveils the vibrant past of a marine trade center in the Red Sea.

programme.title: Strangest Things
programme.desc: Under the muck of a Danish bog, a 2,400-year-old body is found so perfectly preserved the stubble on the dead man's chin is visible … as is the rope around his neck. Is this ancient cold case what it seems? At the turn of the 20th century, physician Albert Abrams was inspired to apply the new discovery of radio waves to medicine. He invented a complex-looking machine to diagnose any disease. Thousands flocked to be tested, but the establishment was skeptical. At Berlin's Neues Museum, a bust of Egypt's Queen Nefertiti portrays a woman so stunning that she has become synonymous with flawless beauty. But when experts use advanced techniques to look beneath the surface, new questions are raised about the queen's appearance.

programme.title: Strangest Things
programme.desc: The mask of Tutankhamun is one of the most famous finds of ancient Egypt, but close inspection reveals a consistent set of strange marks around all the hieroglyphs spelling Tutankhamun's name. Could the name have been engraved over top of another? In North America during World War II, strange and insidious-looking devices made of wood, rope, sandbags and gunpowder were found scattered across the northwestern USA and Canada. Who made them, and what was their sinister purpose? And in East London, a decorative clay bottle from the Middle Ages is uncovered. Not so strange, until the plug was removed and the bottle's contents revealed to include rusty nails, centuries-old human hair, fingernails … and urine. What is this sorcery?

programme.title: Strangest Things
programme.desc: Easter Island's tall stone moai have long captured the global imagination, and there are still mysteries surrounding them. Out of nearly 1,000, why is one particular moai, called Tukuturi, the only one kneeling and sporting a beard? In 1950s USA, sightings of UFOs were a national phenomenon. Alien or not, many Americans didn't realize that the US military was working their own flying saucer: the Avrocar. And just after Newton's discoveries about gravity, 18th-century German physician Franz Anton Mesmer also proposed an invisible force that he called ""animal magnetism." To harness it, he built a device from a giant wooden tub saying it could cure any illness. Patients seemed to corroborate the claim, but could it be true?

programme.title: Endurance
programme.desc: In a legendary feat of leadership and perseverance, Antarctic explorer Ernest Shackleton kept his crew alive for over a year despite losing their ship in frigid pack ice. A century later, a team of explorers sets out to find the sunken ship. These landmark expeditions, bound by shared grit and determination, bookend one of history's greatest sagas of survival and the power of the human spirit.

programme.title: Science of Stupid
programme.desc: Science of Stupid, series 8. Dallas Campbell hosts the show that combines serious science with some of the craziest, most spectacular user generated clips ever recorded. In each programme we show 40 to 50 clips of misadventure: ordinary folk making extraordinary mistakes and paying the price. We analyse the science behind the mishaps, with the help of bespoke animation and super slow-motion cinematography.

programme.title: Running Wild with Bear Grylls
programme.desc: Free Solo rock-climber Alex Honnold joins Bear Grylls for a breathtaking adventure through the Swiss Alps! Alex is no stranger to dizzying heights, but he's not use to falling from them, so Bear kicks off the journey with a skydive into the jagged mountains. From there, it's a six-mile trek through craggy valleys and sheer cliffs where Bear teaches Alex how to survive the wild, but the tables turn when Alex takes Bear on a hair-raising climb!

programme.title: Running Wild with Bear Grylls
programme.desc: On-Air radio personality Bobby Bones joins Bear Grylls for the adventure of a lifetime in a massive Norwegian Fjord! A helicopter ride into the mountains is where their journey begins but from there, danger lurks at every turn - from giant rock domes and deadly bogs to raging rivers with currents strong enough to move cars. On top of that, the only way to reach their extraction is a 300-foot waterfall rappel that leaves even Bobby speechless!

programme.title: Running Wild with Bear Grylls
programme.desc: Bear Grylls and actor Zachary Quinto race the clock to traverse a dense Panamanian jungle before an impending storm makes landfall. Their adventure begins with a helicopter ride, but once dropped off deep in the brush, they must rely on a primitive navigation technique to help them reach their extraction point- but it won't be easy! From massive cliffs and steep ravines to an underground river cave and an old crashed plane, there are obstacles at every turn!

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Minutes before the noise curfew, a privately chartered Gulfstream III is on final approach to Aspen, Colorado amid heavy snow. And though the plane directly ahead aborts its landing due to poor visibility, AvJet N303GA emerges from the clouds, tries to line up with the single runway, and crashes—instantly claiming the lives of all 18 people on board. With no signs of mechanical failure, investigators learn the plane dropped well below minimum altitude on approach. And though a deep dive into the pilots' backgrounds reveals no red flags, the plane's wreckless trajectory begins to make sense when they look into what happened before the late takeoff from Los Angeles. Client pressure blurred the lines between safety and customer satisfaction. And as a result, the confused pilots were determined to land the plane at Aspen—in spite of the risks. Final

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Just minutes after taking off from Lima, the crew of Aeroperú Flight 603 is overwhelmed by a series of conflicting error messages. Flying blind through thick clouds—and unable to confirm either airspeed or altitude—the pilots don't know which alarm they can trust. A controller steps in and dispatches a rescue plane to guide them back to the airport, but help doesn't arrive in time. And just as the crew is troubleshooting over open ocean, the Boeing 757 plunges into the Pacific, instantly killing everyone on board. A Navy expedition to the sea floor proves the plane was intact when it hit the water and successfully retrieves the plane's black boxes. A single image of the wreckage reveals a minor maintenance glitch with deadly repercussions, while the flight data reveals the crew was ill-prepared for a fatal cascade of erroneous data.

programme.title: Europe from Above
programme.desc: Europe from Above takes to the air over Germany, Italy, the Netherlands, Poland, Spain and the UK to showcase Europe's finest cultural and geographical landmarks as you've never seen them before. Stunning aerial hyper-lapse photography allows us to visualise the changes of a season in seconds, as tulip fields in the Netherlands magically burst into colour and waterfalls in the Dolomites turn to ice. We reveal how tradition, engineering and natural wonders have shaped this epic continent - a vibrant portrait of these regions and the people who keep their traditions alive.

programme.title: Europe from Above
programme.desc: This series of spectacular aerial journeys reveal Europe's most remarkable nations as they've never been seen before. From erupting volcanoes in Iceland, to pristine Roman amphitheaters in Croatia and riding record breaking waves in Portugal. This all access aerial documentary lays bare the traditions, innovations and engineering breakthroughs that continue to shape these great modern nations today.

programme.title: Chernobyl: Inside the Meltdown
programme.desc: At 1.23AM on April 26th,1986 a massive explosion rips through reactor number four at Chernobyl nuclear power plant in the Soviet Ukraine. A safety test has triggered the worst nuclear accident in history, releasing 400 times more radiation into the atmosphere than the Hiroshima bomb. While control room operators reel in shock, the nuclear plant's firefighters battle the blaze amidst lethal levels of radiation. Just 3km away in the local town of Pripyat, Communist party officials encourage life to go on as normal. Children go to school and couples get married while radiation rains down on them. Meanwhile a giant radioactive cloud starts to circle the globe. Episode 1 follows the first 24-hours of the disaster, with first-hand accounts from people desperately trying to make sense of an accident no one thought could ever happen.

programme.title: Chernobyl: Inside the Meltdown
programme.desc: On 28th April, fire still rages in what's left of reactor number 4. Helicopter crews trying to put it out are bombarded by massive doses of radiation. Soviet authorities finally order the evacuation of local residents, and 50,000 people are forced to leave their homes. They are told to take enough for 3 days, but they will never come back. Frontline firefighters suffering acute radiation burns are locked in wards controlled by the KGB. Many will die within days. In Sweden high levels of radiation alert the rest of the world to a radioactive cloud sweeping across Europe - evidence of a massive nuclear accident in the USSR. But the Soviet authorities remain silent. Episode Two charts the first two weeks after the meltdown, revealing the human cost of the accident, and the Soviet efforts to conceal the true scale of the disaster.

programme.title: Chernobyl: Inside the Meltdown
programme.desc: Two weeks after the explosion, Soviet authorities race to stop a molten nuclear core from poisoning the water table, and clear deadly radioactive fallout across a 30km exclusion zone. Through the summer of 1986, hundreds of thousands of conscripts and volunteers answer the government's call, to brave lethal radiation levels and build a giant concrete sarcophagus around the destroyed reactor. Meanwhile in Vienna, after months of speculation, the world's nuclear experts gather to hear the Soviet account of what caused the catastrophe. Is Gorbachev's promise of Glasnost finally revealing the truth from behind the Iron Curtain? Or could this be the Soviet's biggest cover up yet? Episode Three uncovers the extraordinary battle to build the most perilous construction project in history told by those who those who were there 40 years ago.

programme.title: Chernobyl: Inside the Meltdown
programme.desc: Over a year after the accident, plant operators accused of causing the catastrophe face a Soviet show trial. Inside the power plant, nearly 200 tonnes of lethally radioactive nuclear fuel has gone missing. Scientists hunt for it deep inside the perilous reactor core. As the USSR collapses, an independent investigation searches for evidence of what happened the night of the meltdown, uncovering classified documents that reveal what really caused the explosion, and powerful evidence for a Soviet cover up. Chernobyl's toxic legacy continues right up to the present-day war in Ukraine, when the nuclear exclusion zone turns into a war zone, and the power plant itself comes under attack, raising fears of another nuclear disaster. Episode four reveals how 40-years on, the Chernobyl catastrophe is more relevant than ever.

programme.title: Drain the Oceans: Deep Dive
programme.desc: For centuries treasure ships sailed the oceans of the world...packed with silver, gold and precious stones. Hunted by pirates. Battered by storms. Threatened by reefs and rocky shores. Around the world, countless treasures and wrecks remain unexplored. Now, new underwater scientific surveys explore the deep oceans, powerful computers turn data in to 3D images, and we can examine sunken treasures in detail from any angle. Draining the oceans throws new light on the richest wrecks in the world.

programme.title: How the Tudors Lost Their Heads
programme.desc: For centuries, Mary, Queen of Scots has been dismissed as impulsive and self-destructive. Now, through new evidence and rare access, Professor Suzannah Lipscomb and Dan Snow uncover deeper layers to this most famous historical figure. Travelling through France, Scotland and England, they trace Mary's journey from educated princess to embattled and imprisoned queen. They examine extraordinary documents, including recently unearthed coded letters, and reveal a woman who was charismatic, strategic and strong-willed, but who faced daunting odds, powerful enemies, violence and betrayal. As they investigate pivotal moments that led to her execution, Suzannah and Dan reassess Mary. Was her tragic fate really down to her own actions and temperament? Or did her cousin, Elizabeth I, along with scheming spymasters, deliver the final blow?

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: En route to Boise, Idaho, Continental Airlines Flight 1713 is delayed on the tarmac in Denver where controllers struggle to keep departures on schedule amid heavy snow. When the plane is finally cleared for take-off, the DC-9 barely lifts off the ground before its banks sharply and crashes. Investigators find nothing wrong with the aircraft itself, but what they eventually uncover changes commercial flight forever.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Harrowing stories of tragedy and triumph are brought to life through official reports, transcripts and interviews with the pilots, air traffic controllers and lucky survivors of history's most terrifying crashes. Widely considered to be the safest form of travel, air transportation is still in its infancy and when midair calamity strikes, the results are often catastrophic. From the cockpit to the cabin, from the control room to the crash scene, we uncover just what went wrong.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation

programme.title: Drain the Oceans: Deep Dive
programme.desc: Extreme weather patterns have threatened ships and mariners for centuries. The perfect storm?. towering walls of water, powerful winds and churning seas can overwhelm any ship. What brought down the largest haul of Spanish treasure off the coast of Florida? And what's the truth behind the strange disappearance of the mightiest invasion force of ancient times? Drain the Oceans reveals the secrets of Stormy Seas.

programme.title: Drain the Oceans: Deep Dive
programme.desc: Under the seas lives a lost graveyard of sunken war ships. Countless vessels from WWI and WWII pepper the seafloor. Among those, some of the most powerful weapons ever built. But with the evidence lost deep beneath the waves, these stories remain cloaked in mystery. Who won the battle of Jutland? And how did a scuttling in Scapa Flow lead to Nazi Germanys advancement in wartime submarines? Scientific data combines with computer graphic will help investigate the lost wrecks of WWI and WWII.

programme.title: Mysteries of Ancient Medicine
programme.desc: From the bizarre to the brilliant, ancient medicine reveals humanity's boldest attempts to heal. European medical texts once praised powdered mummy as a cure all, spurring demand for human remains taken from Egyptian tombs. In Austria, villagers consumed arsenic, believing controlled doses improved their complexion, breathing and vitality — despite its lethal nature. Far across the world, in ancient Mayan lands, a sweat bath carved with a powerful deity offers insight into rituals surrounding pregnancy and birth. Through archaeology and expert insight, the episode reveals how different cultures embraced unconventional treatments, each shaped by fear, tradition, and a desire to understand the body.

programme.title: Mysteries of Ancient Medicine
programme.desc: Across continents and centuries, ancient peoples sought protection and healing in surprising ways. European nobility, terrified of assassination, embraced bezoar stones as powerful antidotes capable of counteracting poison. In Egypt, healers turned to the Nile's electric catfish, conducting early bioelectrical experiments to ease pain and treat ailments. Far to the east in Turpan, archaeologists uncover a burial surrounded by cannabis plants — evidence of ritual, medicinal or symbolic practices tied to the plant's unique properties. Through expert insights and archaeological evidence, this episode explores how fear, curiosity and spiritual belief shaped some of the most unexpected treatments in ancient medicine.

programme.title: How the Tudors Lost Their Heads
programme.desc: In 1491, a finely dressed young man travels Europe claiming to be Richard, Duke of York, one of England's disappeared Princes in the Tower, and the country's true king. The man quickly attracts backing from European rulers who see him as a vehicle for unseating the current king, Henry VII. Henry would go down in history as the founder of the Tudor dynasty, the young man as Perkin Warbeck, a failed and executed pretender. Suzannah Lipscomb and Dan Snow trace the cat-and-mouse contest between Henry and his rival. It's a tale of espionage, unsuccessful invasions and shifting alliances. They uncover evidence at the heart of one of history's most enduring mysteries: Was Perkin an imposter, just a young lad from Belgium caught up in European power politics, or was he really the rightful heir to the English throne?

programme.title: Last of the Giants
programme.desc: Cyril and his team embark on an unprecedented adventure in the wildest, dangerous and unexplored regions of the world. Their mission: to find the last endangered species of giant fish and take samples for scientific purposes in order to better understand the exact causes of their disappearance. Their challenge: survive in hostile environments and extreme conditions to protect these impressive aquatic creatures.

programme.title: Running Wild with Bear Grylls
programme.desc: Free Solo rock-climber Alex Honnold joins Bear Grylls for a breathtaking adventure through the Swiss Alps! Alex is no stranger to dizzying heights, but he's not use to falling from them, so Bear kicks off the journey with a skydive into the jagged mountains. From there, it's a six-mile trek through craggy valleys and sheer cliffs where Bear teaches Alex how to survive the wild, but the tables turn when Alex takes Bear on a hair-raising climb!

programme.title: Running Wild with Bear Grylls
programme.desc: On-Air radio personality Bobby Bones joins Bear Grylls for the adventure of a lifetime in a massive Norwegian Fjord! A helicopter ride into the mountains is where their journey begins but from there, danger lurks at every turn - from giant rock domes and deadly bogs to raging rivers with currents strong enough to move cars. On top of that, the only way to reach their extraction is a 300-foot waterfall rappel that leaves even Bobby speechless!

programme.title: Science of Stupid
programme.desc: Science of Stupid, series 8. Dallas Campbell hosts the show that combines serious science with some of the craziest, most spectacular user generated clips ever recorded. In each programme we show 40 to 50 clips of misadventure: ordinary folk making extraordinary mistakes and paying the price. We analyse the science behind the mishaps, with the help of bespoke animation and super slow-motion cinematography.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. This new series travels with him across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness.

programme.title: Germany's Magic Mountains
programme.desc: The quiet charm of Germany's Central Uplands lies in ancient forests and wild beauty. Through the autumn forest, the booming call of a stag echoes through the mist. It's rutting season! In Saxon Switzerland, peregrine falcons and black storks inhabit picturesque cliffs. The elusive lynx roams the forests, while in the Harz, a new, wilder forest is growing in the shifting climate.

programme.title: Africa's Hidden Wonders
programme.desc: A land full of extreme environments and teeming with iconic wildlife, Africa holds a fascination like no other continent. This series takes the viewer on a journey from harsh desert landscapes to towering peaks, and from vast, sprawling grasslands to raging river torrents. The three episodes cover the mist-covered jungles and mountains of Rwanda and the great apes who call it home; the largest desert in the world, the Sahara, where the scarcity of water and food make life a daily challenge for the creatures who compete for them; and the cradle of humanity, Ethiopia, a weather-ravaged land full of natural beauty and unique wildlife.

programme.title: Land of the Iberian Lynx
programme.desc: Winter. Sierra Morena is a mountain range of climatic extremes. The harsh winter puts the lynxes of the Jandula River Valley to the test. Golden eagles, otters, wild boars and cormorants struggle to survive in the land of the Iberian lynx.

programme.title: Land of the Iberian Lynx
programme.desc: Spring rains bring new opportunities and hope to the land of the Iberian lynx.

programme.title: Secrets of the Bullshark
programme.desc: We know Bull Sharks swim upriver and we know they hunt in the sea. But we've never been able to see it all like this. We see them attack and consume other sharks. We watch their shady hunts in the deep. We follow them up freshwater rivers to pupping grounds. We see them hunt shoals of fish from drones above and we watch as they clash with hippos and crocs.

programme.title: Untamed Philippines: Hidden Wonders
programme.desc: National Geographic Wild. A nation of more than 100 million people on a collection of over 7,600 islands all set in the warm emerald seas of the Pacific Ocean, the Philippines is a land of sparkling wonder and contrasts.

programme.title: Nature's Nurseries - The Next Wild Generation
programme.desc: Across the world, every species faces the same challenge: giving the next generation the best possible start. From gardens and farms to open fields and remote coastlines, animals raise their young in environments shaped by opportunity and risk. Sparrows and storks build homes alongside humans, making use of food and shelter, while butterflies depend on precise plant life to sustain their offspring. In open landscapes, skylarks nest far from disturbance, relying on camouflage and timing. In harsher climates, survival demands even more adaptation. Puffins time their chicks' arrival to brief seasons of abundance, while musk oxen shield newborns from freezing winds. Through intimate stories and striking settings, these journeys reveal how instinct, environment and resilience shape life's earliest and most vulnerable moments.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Phil Breslin, third generation Indigenous educator, biologist and adventurer is on a quest to reveal some of the strangest and most specialised animal adaptations on the planet. Focusing on Australia's incredibly varied landscapes and environments, Phil yarns with First Nations people about habitats, traverses deserts, dives in the ocean's depths and uses science to identify Australia's ultimate animal survivors.

programme.title: Built to Survive

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: The sparse African Savannah can be a fearsome place for both herds of powerful prey and the lurking predators who hunt them down. In this captivating documentary series from National Geographic, the relationship between predator and prey is closely examined, exploring the fight for survival for both sets of animals. These herds are full of powerful or agile animals, making the job of a predator to feed itself and its family a troublesome task. But the African predators are ruthless and proficient hunters, and if a herd is infiltrated, or a straggling member is targeted, they will struggle to evade these savage carnivores.

programme.title: Germany's Magic Mountains
programme.desc: Surviving in the Alps. The Alps are changing, not in dramatic leaps but in slow, steady shifts. Rising temperatures and decades of human activity are transforming this once-stable mountain region. It's rutting season!

programme.title: Seen on Safari
programme.desc: Expect the Unexpected. Safari action is unpredictable. A lion captures birds midair, a baboon steals a leopard cub, a hyena plays tug-of-war with a crocodile, and a terrapin chases a lion away from his waterhole.

But the African predators are ruthless and proficient hunters, and if a herd is infiltrated, or a straggling member is targeted, they will struggle to evade these savage carnivores.

programme.title: Lion Brothers: Cubs To Kings
programme.desc: There's one thing that Leo has on his mind from birth - power. And he'll stop at nothing to get it. But life has other ideas and throws the book at this young upstart. With brother Max by his side, can Leo face his challenges and overcome his arrogance to become the King he's always dreamed he'd be?

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. This new series travels with him across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The family goes into hyperdrive to fix the pasture fence and finish building the garden hardscape before the first snow falls; Beth is worried about the bees, so she brings in some expert help to hopefully ensure their survival.

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor
programme.desc: Follow the exploits of these cute creatures from northern New Mexico. "Prairie Dog Manor" showcases the unique behaviour of these special animals and highlights the different relationships that exist between the clan members from Valles Caldera National Preserve. Beginning with the prairie dogs preparing for the coming winter, Carl and the pups get ready for hibernation. But they face danger from an unlikely source as deadly predators forge an alliance to threaten every dog in the territory. Further episodes explore the mating season when the warm weather arrives and battles commence between the males to earn the right to mate with the females. Soon, the females are pregnant and new pups arrive and the whole cycle starts again.

programme.desc: The Docs at Critter Fixer attend to a severely dehydrated cat with feline leukemia and a rescued black wolf that was shot. They also perform an emergency C-section on a dog with a litter of ten puppies. And several members of the staff enjoy the perks of the job to bring their own pets in for treatment, including Pauls goldfish who need surgery to remove giant tumors.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbaliba, Barbalala un Barbabella pēc kārtas stāsta stāstu. Katra iekļauj tajā ko ļoti personīgu. Barbapapu ģimene pavada dienu pludmalē. Sadalījušies 2 komandās, barbabērni cīnās par smilšu pussalu.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: No kalna izbēdzis āzis izraisa haosu, aprīdams visu, kas pagadās! Bali nekur nav atrodama, un Barbapapa liek lietā savu attapību, meklējot viņu. Viņi pat nenojauš, kāds pārsteigums viņus gaida.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbagudrais izturas dīvaini. Ko viņš slēpj? Barbabērni darīs visu, lai to uzzinātu. Barbapapas izlemj taupīt elektrību, taču viņu ieceri izjauc Barbagudrais un Barbabella, kas izgudrojuši slepenu elektrību patērējošu projektu.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbabērni pielipuši pie televizora, tāpēc vecāki mudina viņus veidot raidījumus. Barbapapas apmeklē evolūcijas muzeju. Programmā: Zemes radīšana, Pirmskembrija perioda zemūdene un... dinozauri!

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Kad stirnai Podziņai jāšķērso Celtnieklīča lidostas skrejceļš, Rabls un komanda zina, kas jābūvē. Rabls un komanda uzbūvē milzu skrituļdēli tantes Celtnes un Rivera šovam. Taču, kad tas zaudē kontroli, suņiem jādzenas pakaļ!

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Celtnieklīcim vajadzīga pasta nodaļa! Bet, kad celtni apsēž vāveres, suņiem jāizdomā risinājums. Rabla komanda izmanto savas būvniecības prasmes, lai pārveidotu super auto mazgātavu un nomazgātu fermeres Zojas sušķīgos dzīvniekus.

programme.title: Ķepu patruļa
programme.desc: "Ķepu patruļa" ir seriāls pirmsskolas vecuma bērniem, kura galvenie varoņi ir seši varonīgi kucēni Čeiss, Māršals, Rokijs, Zuma, Rabls un Skaja, kuru saimnieks ir tehnoloģijas pārzinošais 10 gadus vecais zēns Raiders. Viņiem ir unikālas problēmu risināšanas spējas, stilīgi braucamrīki un daudz kucēniem raksturīga mīļa humora. "Kepu patruļa" dodas bīstamās glābšanas misijās, lai Piedzīvojumu līča iedzīvotāji būtu drošībā. Māršals – suns ugunsdzējs, Čeiss – suns policists, Skaja, kura lido savā helikopterā, un citi – katram kucēnam ir sava īpaša personība un spējas, atspoguļojot kopīga darba un pilsoniskās atbildības nozīmību. Viņiem visiem uz muguras ir īpašas mugursomas, lai viņi būtu spējīgi paveikt visu, sākot no kaķēnu glābšanas līdz vilciena apturēšanai, neļaujot tam nokrist no klints. Lai cik liels būtu piedzīvojums, "Ķepu patruļai" vienmēr atliek laiks spēlēm, jautrībai un tam, lai Raiders pakasa aiz auss. Interesants "Ķepu patruļas" fakts – Raders izglāba visus kucēnus un iemācīja tiem viņu spējas.
